samas.samasTitleEnglish: Lekhankriya Nirupan (A Discourse on the Act of Writing)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: ब्राह्मणें बाळबोध अक्षर । घडसुनी करावें सुंदर । जें देखतांचि चतुर । समाधान पावती ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्राह्मणानें बाळबोध अक्षर घोटून घोटून सुंदर करावें. तें अक्षर पाहून चतुरांना समाधान वाटावें.
owis.englishMeaning: The brahmin should make this beautiful knowledge that is like that of a new born child, into that indestructible swarup. Then while in this body, this wise thought of mula maya will become that thoughtless complete contentment of Reality.

owis.original: वाटोळें सरळें मोकळें । वोतलें मसीचें काळें । कुळकुळीत वळी चालिल्या ढाळें । मुक्तमाळा जैशा ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अक्षर वाटोळें, मोकळें, सरळ असावें. तें काळ्या शाईनें लिहिलेले असावें. काळें कुळकुळीत दिसावें. ओळी जणूं मोत्यांच्या माळेप्रमाणें दिसाव्यात.
owis.englishMeaning: mula maya is a point only (maharaj- knowledge is said to be a point. It means nothing is there). It flows easily and freely, just like the ink from a pen. And wherever this continuous line flows, it sheds a light that forms a `garland of liberation' (then wherever you go and whatever you see is knowledge).

owis.original: अक्षरमात्र तितुकें नीट । नेमस्त पैस काने नीट । आडव्या मात्रा त्या हि नीट । आर्कुलीं वेलांड्या ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रत्येक अक्षर नीट लिहिलेले असावें. प्रत्येक शब्दांत सारखें अंतर असावें. काने व आडव्या मात्रासुद्धा नीट असाव्यात. त्याचप्रमाणें रफार व वेलांट्या नीट हव्यात.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this well formed line (ie. the single thought `I am knowing') there is that indestructible swarup. It is so open and *empty and the secret meaning of the scriptures. But contrary to this perfectly formed line there are the `many' crooked lines (ie. the `many' thoughts) that create these objects of the senses. *(maharaj- be empty inside)

owis.original: पहिलें अक्षर जें काढिलें । ग्रंथ संपेतों पाहात गेलें । येका टांकेंचि लिहिलें । ऐसें वाटे ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ग्रंथ आरंभ करतांना पहिल्या अक्षराचे जे वळण आहे, तेच वळण ग्रंथ संपेपर्यंत असावें. ग्रंथ एक टाकी लिहिलेला आहे असें वाटलें पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: Originally there had only been that indestructible Self and then, there was the writing of this story of mula maya. And the writing of this scripture will be concluded only when the understanding of that indestructible Self dawns. Therefore you should feel that this writing has come from this one never changing point (maharaj- how can you be that which is changing every moment?). 1 siddharameshwar maharaj. the only true brahmin is the knower of brahman

owis.original: अक्षराचें काळेपण । टांकाचें ठोसरपण । तैसेंचि वळण वांकाण । सारिखेंचि ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ग्रंथांतील अक्षरांचा काळेपणा, टाकाचा टणकपणा आणि अक्षरांची वळणें व वांकणें हीं आरंभापासून अखेरपर्यंत एकसारखीं असावी.
owis.englishMeaning: When this `writing' made by that indestructible Self is the thickness of this *point then, any form or fault of the mind becomes this point only (there is only yourself in the world). *(maharaj- what is the volume of knowledge? It cannot be said. Wherever you put it, there it will go. If you make it big, it becomes big. If you make it small then it is small)

owis.original: वोळीस वोळी लागेना । आर्कुली मात्र भेदीना । खालिले वोळीस स्पर्शेना । अथवा लंबाक्षर ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ओळीला ओळ लागूं नये. रफारानें मात्रेचा घेद करुं नये. अक्षरांच्या खालच्या ओळीला स्पर्श होऊं नये. तसेंच अक्षर लांबट असूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: This thought `I am knowing' does not meet with any other thoughts nor can the crooked tendencies of the mind penetrate this thought. Inferior thoughts cannot touch this thought `I am knowing'; so how can they touch that everlasting indestructible Self?

owis.original: पान शिषानें रेखाटावें । त्यावरी नेमकचि ल्याहावें । दुरी जवळी न व्हावें । अंतर वोळीचें ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शिशानें पानावर रेघा आखाव्या. त्यावर ठरलेली शब्दसंख्याच प्रत्येक ओळींत लिहावी. सर्व ओळींच्यामधील अंतर अगदी सारखें असावें. ओळी दूर व जवळ नसाव्यात.
owis.englishMeaning: The disciple's mind should be like a blank sheet of paper and on that, he should write this story of God very carefully. This line should not be broken by the divisions of near and far, dear ones or strangers (ie. stay with the people but do not care for the people; maharaj- arjuna had to kill his relations. But how to kill them? Understand they are not my relatives; they are relatives of the body. Then they are dead or not?).

owis.original: कोठें शोधासी आडेना । चुकी पाहातां सांपडेना । गरज केली हें घडेना । लेखकापासुनी ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोठें शोध घालायचा असेल तर अडचण पडूं नये. लिहिण्यामधें शोधूनही चूक सापडूं नये. लिहिण्यामधें लेखकानें हेळसांड केली असें कधीं वाटूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: Whenever you search out this `story' then, where will any obstruction remain? Whe- never you understand then, this mistake called ignorance cannot be found. But if the writer needs to keep `writing' then, that thoughtless Self will not be accomplished (ie. this `I am' thought should be absorbed in thoughtlessness).

owis.original: ज्याचें वय आहे नूतन । त्यानें ल्याहावें जपोन । जनासी पडे मोहन । ऐसें करावें ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याचे वय लहान आहे त्यानें फार जपून लिहावें. आपण लिहिलेले लोकांना पाहाण्याचा मोह होईल असें लिहावें.
owis.englishMeaning: The life of that purush (ie. the writer/witness) is fresh and always new. He should repeat this writing continuously and even while in the `people', this silence should not be broken.

owis.original: बहु बारिक तरुणपणीं । कामा नये म्हातारपणीं । मध्यस्त लिहिण्याची करणी केली पाहिजे ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तरुणपणीं फार बारीकअक्षर लिहिलेले चालेल. पण म्हातारपणीं तें उपयोगी पडत नाहीं. म्हणून मध्यम आकाराचें अक्षर काढण्याची सवय करावी.
owis.englishMeaning: When one is too young and in the `many' thoughts then, this `I am' remains hidden and it should not be wanted only when one grows old ("Oh! The Saints were right; I should have listened to them"). Therefore between these two, this wonderful writing should be made (maharaj- at this moment you are He).

owis.original: भोंवलें स्थळ सोडून द्यावें । मधेंचि चमचमित ल्याहावें । कागद झडतांहि झडावें । नलगेचि अक्षर ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण जें लिहितो त्याच्याभोवतीं मोकळी जागा सोडावी. मध्यें छान, स्पष्ट व ठसठशीत लिहावें. कालांतरानें कागद झडला तरी अक्षरें सुरक्षित राहावीत.
owis.englishMeaning: This whirling, confusing place should be left aside and there should be this writing within and then this place of abundance will be formed (ie. when nothing is there, then everything is there). Then this feeble mind should be let go, for it is not needed by that indestructible Self (no-mind).

owis.original: ऐसा ग्रंथ जपोनी ल्याहावा । प्राणीमात्रास उपजे हेवा । ऐसा पुरुष तो पहावा । म्हणती लोक ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशारीतीनें ग्रंथ अगदी जपून लिहुन काढावा. लोकांनात्याचा हेवा वाटला पाहिजे. इतका सुंदर ग्रंथ लिहुन काढणारा कोण पुरुष आहे, त्याला एकदा पाहावा असें लोकांना वाटले पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: There should arise a longing within the prana to write this story `I am'. If this longing is there then, this scripture can be written and cared for. Then that purush will understand this, that the people call, the world.

owis.original: काया बहुत कष्टवावी । उत्कट कीर्ति उरवावी । चटक लाउनी सोडावी । कांहीं येक ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा प्रकारे ग्रंथ लिहून देण्यामधें आपले शरीर खूप झिझवावे. आपल्या मागें आपली उत्तम कीर्ति उरेल असें वागावें. लोकांना आपल्याबद्दल उत्कंठा लागेल असेंच आपण करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: This body of the `all' should take much trouble and then only its pervasiveness effectively remains (ie. let whatever is going to come anyway, let it come. Why should I be affected). Fondness and craving should be left aside by that One within this `thing' (ie. everything that comes is my choice now).

owis.original: घट्य कागद आणावे । जपोन नेमस्त खळावे । लिहिण्याचे सामे असावे । नानापरी ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चांगला घट्ट कागद असावा. तो काळजीपूर्वक नीट खळावा. त्याच्यावर लिहिण्यासाठीं लागणारें नाना प्रकारचे सामान जवळ असावें.
owis.englishMeaning: The writing and this blank paper (ie. inner space) should be known and then the repetitions of the `many' thoughts will surely stop. For the ways of the `many' will be pacified by this writing.

owis.original: सुर्‍या कातर्‍या जागाईत । खळी घोंटाळें तागाईत । नाना सुरंग मिश्रित । जाणोनि घ्यावें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सुर्‍या, कातर्‍या, समास, फळ्या, खळ, घोटा, खळ लावण्याचा ब्रश,चाकूला व सुरीला धार लावण्याचे सुरेख रंगाचे दगड, यावस्तु चांगल्या नीट पाहून घ्याव्या.
owis.englishMeaning: The frightened watchman should be given a sword (ie. the sword of knowledge) until this confusion and bewilderment is brought to an end. Then this beautiful state that has been mixed with the `many' other states should be known and accepted (as soon as you leave everything, this `I am' is knowing; but an acceptor is required).

owis.original: नाना देसीचे बरु आणावे । घटी बातिक सरळे घ्यावे । नाना रंगाचे आणावे । नाना जिनसी ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निरनिराळ्या देशांतून बोरु मागवावे. त्यापैकी जे घट्ट, टणक, बारीक व सरळ असतील ते वापरायला घ्यावे.अनेक रंगाचें अनेक प्रकारचे बोरु जवळ असावेत.
owis.englishMeaning: The `many' bodies from the `many' places should be all brought together (by the eyes of knowledge) and that hidden purush and this easy `thing', within these created things, should be accepted. In this way, this splendour of `I am' should be brought into the `many' objects.

owis.original: नाना जिनसी टांकतोडणी । नाना प्रकारें रेखाटणी । चित्रविचित्र करणी । सिसेंलोळ्या ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बोरुची टोकें तोडण्यासाठीं अनेक प्रकारच्या टांक तोडणी असाव्या. अनेक प्रकारच्या ओळी आखण्यासाठीं पट्ट्या किंवा रुळ असावेत. अनेल प्रकारची चित्रें ग्रंथामधें काढावी. वजनासाठीं शिश्याच्या गोळ्या जवळ ठेवाव्या.
owis.englishMeaning: In the `many' objects there is the breaking of this writing. In the `many' forms there is the drying up of this line. This marvellous wonder will only appear in the mind that is tranquil and free of any greed.

owis.original: हिंगुळ संग्रहीं असावे । वाळले आळिते पाहोन घ्यावे । सोपें भिजऊनी वाळवावे । संग्रह मसीचे ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हिंगुळ आपल्याजवळ ठेवावा. वाळलेला अळता म्हणजे कापसाचा वाळलेला रंगीतबोळा पाहून जवळ ठेवावा. निरनिराळ्या शाईचे सोपे भिजवून वाळवावे. व जवळ ठेवावे.
owis.englishMeaning: That which is your own, should be stored up. That which has been dried up and become gross should be understood and accepted (ie. this free flowing knowledge is your nature. But an acceptor is required). And that which is empty and flourishing due to these waters of objectification should be dried up and this thought `I am knowing' stored there.

owis.original: तगटी इतिश्र्या कराव्या । बंदरी फळ्या घोटाव्या । नाना चित्रीं चिताराव्या । उंच चित्रें ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ग्रंथ लिहून पूर्ण झाला कीं शेवटी " इतिश्री " असें लिहावें. बंदरावरुन अणलेल्या उत्तम प्रतीच्या सागवान घोटीव फळ्यांवर सुंदर चित्रें काढावीत.
owis.englishMeaning: All that has been imagined should be completely destroyed. All that has come from outside should be endured (let whatever comes, come). Then the `many' mirages will be covered over by the light of the vast paramatma.

owis.original: नाना गोप नाना बासनें । मेणकापडें सिंदुरवर्णे । पेट्या कुलपें जपणें । पुस्तकाकारणें ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ग्रंथ लिहून झाल्यावर तो गोफ, रेशमाचे विणलेले दोर, ग्रंथ बांधण्यासाठीं अनेक वस्त्रें, मेणकापड वगैरे जवळ असावें. ग्रंथ ठेवण्यासाठीं पेट्या, कुलुपें जवळ असावी.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the `many' plays and the `many' desires wrapped up in this disgusting old worn wax-cloth (ie. a body). Its authority has been secured and preserved due to the repetition of so many thoughts (ie. from many books and not this scripture). .

owis.original: मागां बोलिले लेखनभेद । आतां ऐका अर्थभेद । नाना प्रकारीचे संवाद । समजोन घ्यावे ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मागील समासांत ग्रंथ कसा लिहून काढायचा तें सांगितलें. आतां या समासांत ग्रंथाचा अर्थ कसा समजून घ्यावा तें सांगतो. समाजनेत्यानें अनेक प्रकारचे संवाद समजून घ्यावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Previously this `speech' had been the `many' different writings of the people. Now, listen carefully and afterwards penetrate the meaning within this `speech'. Then the ways of the `many' can be understood and this wordless dialogue between the Master and disciple can be accepted.

owis.original: शब्दभेद अर्थभेद । मुद्राभेद प्रबंदभेद । नाना शब्दाचे शब्दभेद । जाणोनी पाहावे ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शब्दांचे वेगवेगळे प्रकार, अर्थाचे निरनिराळे प्रकार, मुद्रांचें वेगवेगळे प्रकार, काव्याचे निरनिराळे प्रकार, निरनिराळ्या शब्दांचे निरनिराळे अर्थ त्यानें समजून घ्यावें.
owis.englishMeaning: In this world there are the `many' different words and their `many' different mea- nings; there are the `many' different kinds of prints and different compositions. But by forgetting all these and effortlessly knowing, one can penetrate this *`word' within the `many' words and understand its innermost meaning. (From this original `word', many words have come. Now drop the many words and experience this `word'. Then only can its meaning be understood; maharaj- the words are empty; the meaning is paramatma) *(Penetrate within this present `moment' and find life)

owis.original: नाना आशंका प्रत्योत्तरें । नाना प्रचित साक्षात्कारें । जेणेंकरितां जगदांतरें । चमत्कारती ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नाना प्रकारच्या शंका आणि त्यांची उत्तरें, अनेक प्रकारच्या अनुभवाच्या गोष्टी व अनेक प्रकारच्या साक्षात्काराच्या घटना त्यानें समजून घ्याव्या, त्यास त्या माहित असाव्या. त्या गोष्टी व घटना ऐकून लोकांना आश्र्चर्य वाटते.
owis.englishMeaning: The `many' doubts will be removed by this reply, `I am'. And these `many' doubts and this `I am' are due to that nirgun Self. Then on account of this `I am', this world will be filled with awe and wonder.

owis.original: नाना पूर्वपक्ष सिद्धांत । प्रत्ययो पाहावा नेमस्त । अनुमानाचें खस्तवेस्त । बोलोंचि नये ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक प्रकारचे पूर्वपक्ष व सिद्धान्त यांचा स्वतः खात्रीपूर्वक अनुभव घेतलेला असावा. असें असलें म्हणजे लोकांना ठासून सांगता येते. नाहींतर निश्र्चयपूर्वक सांगता येत नाही. समाजनेत्यानें केवळ अनुमानानें उगीच कांहींतरी अस्ताव्यस्त बोलूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: Within this world there are the `many' thoughts, this understanding `I am' and that eternal Truth (I do not exist). The limited jiva should understand that nirgun Self and therefore, this `speech' should not be full of wild conjecture.

owis.original: प्रवृत्ति अथवा निवृत्ती । प्रचितीविण अवघी भ्रांती । गळंग्यामधील जगज्जोति । चेतेल कोठें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रवृत्ति असो वा निवृत्ति असो, प्रपंच असो वा परमार्थ असो, दोन्हीकडे जर अनुभव नसेल तर सगळा भ्रमाचा घोटाळा असतो. ज्याप्रमाणें चघळचोथ्यामध्यें अग्नि पेट घेत नाहीं, त्याचप्रमाणें केवळ अनुमानाच्या वक्तृत्वानें आणि ज्ञानानें लोकांच्या अंतःकरणांतील जगत्ज्योत पेटणार नाहीं. लोकांच्या अंतरांतील अंतरात्मा जागा होणार नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: In this world, there can be this worldly activity ("I am a body") or there can be the cessation of all this worldly activity/nivritti (no-knowledge or pure knowledge). But without understanding this `I am', the incoherent whirl of these `many' thoughts will remain and tell me, how then can this `light of the world' (`I am'/existence) be kindled within a bundle of confusion?

owis.original: हेत समजोन उत्तर देणें । दुसर्‍याचे जीवीचे समजणें । मुख्य च्यातुर्याचीं लक्षणें । तें हें ऐसीं ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रश्र्ण विचारणार्‍याचा हेतु ओळखून उत्तर द्यावें. दुसर्‍याचे अंतर्गत समजून घ्यावें. चतुरपणाची लक्षणें ही अशी आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: The understanding of this original intent (ie. `I just want to be') is the giving of the proper *`reply'.2 It is the understanding of this `all' body within the jiva. And that Supreme is understood due to this attention of the wise. *(maharaj reply to the mind so nicely, that the mind goes off.)

owis.original: च्यातुर्येविण खटपट । ते विद्याचि फलकट । सभेमधें आटघाट । समाधान कैचें ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याच्या अंगी असा चतुरपणा नाहीम त्याची खटपट व्यर्थ आहे. त्याची विद्या फोलकट असते. सभेमध्यें विनाकारण वाटाघाट केल्यानें समाधान होणार नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Without such wisdom there is only trouble and squabbling and then that Reality becomes the empty and vain learnings of this world. If within this meeting place of the `all', there is only the exchange of arguments then truly, how will there ever be complete contentment?

owis.original: बहुत बोलणें ऐकावें । तेथें मोन्यचि धरावें । अल्पचिन्हें समजावें । जगदांतर ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दुसर्‍याचे पुष्कळ बोलणें ऐकून घ्यावें. पण आपण मात्र मौन धरावें. लहानशा खुणेवरुन लोकांच्या मनांत काय आहे तें ओळखावें.
owis.englishMeaning: First this `speech' of the `all' should be listened to and then, `there' in brahman, silence/mouna should be maintained. Therefore this delicate `speech' within the gross world should be understood.

owis.original: बाष्कळामध्यें बैसों नये । उद्धटासीं तंडों नये । आपणाकरितां खंडों नये । समाधान जनाचें ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वात्रट लोकांत बसूं नये. उद्धट माणसाच्या तोंडी लागूं नये. आपल्या वागण्यानेम लोकांचे समाधान कधीं मोडूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: With the wild and frivolous mind one should not sit. With the rough and rude mind, one should not quarrel. And that complete contentment within the `people' should not be broken on account of you.

owis.original: नेणतपण सोडूं नये । जाणपणें फुगों नये । नाना जनाचें हृदये । मृद शब्दें उकलावें ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपले अजाणतेपण सोडूं नये. जाणतेपणानें कधीहीं ताठा धरुं नये. गोड व मृदु शब्दांनीं अनेक लोकांच्या अंतःकरणांतील भाव उकलावा.
owis.englishMeaning: `I know nothing', this thought should never be left, for you should not get puffed up with this knowing. In this way, by this soft `word', the heart of the man in the `many' thoughts will be opened and disentangled.

owis.original: प्रसंग जाणावा नेटका । बहुतांसी जाझु घेऊं नका । खरें असतांचि नासका । फड होतो ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रसंग कसाआहे, तें बरोबर ओळखावें. फार माणसांबरोबर उगीच हुज्जत घालूं नये. अशा हुज्जतीमुळें आपले म्हणने खरें असूनही लोकांना पटत नाही. आणि त्यामुळें समुहामध्यें बेदिली होते.
owis.englishMeaning: This proper connection should be known and then there should be no quarrelling with this `all' (ie. keep your mind away and simply know). Otherwise the Truth will get spoiled and It will all end up like a circus.

owis.original: शोध घेतां आळसों नये । भ्रष्ट लोकीं बैसों नये । बैसलें तरी टाकूं नये । मिथ्या दोष ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणत्याही गोष्टीचा शोध घेण्याचा कंटाळा करुं नये. भ्रष्ट लोकांत बसूं नये. बसावेच लागले तर त्यांच्यावर खोटे आरोप करुं नयेत.
owis.englishMeaning: Accept this search wholeheartedly and do not become lazy. Therefore do not sit in the company of the degraded and confused (ie. stay out of your mind). However if one sits there, then one should not find fault with it (ie. remain disinterested and detached).

owis.original: अंतर आर्ताचें शोधावें । प्रसंगीं थोडें चि वाचावें । चटक लाउनी सोडावें । भल्या मनुष्यासी ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें दुःखी लोक असतील त्यांच्या अंतरांत शिरुन त्यांचे दुःख हलके  करावें. वेळप्रसंगी थोडेंच वाचावें. पण भलत्या माणसांना आपली चटक लावूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: This inner space should search out the cause of its sufferings and the Knower should be its witness. The wise should leave the longings and likings to mankind.

owis.original: मज्यालसींत बैसों नये । समाराधनेसी जाऊं नये । जातां लेळीलवाणें होये । जिणें आपुलें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सभेमध्यें बसूं नये. यात्रा किंवा अनुष्ठान यांच्या उद्यापनास जावूं नये. अशा प्रसंगाना आपण जात राहिलो तर आपल्या अंगी मिंधेपणा उत्पन्न होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not stay idle within one's power (exert this `God-given' power to know; see 18.6, the gifts acquired through witnessing); one should not go after entertainment and gratification and then your living will be with dignity.

owis.original: उत्तम गुण प्रगटवावे । मग भलत्यासी बोलतां फावे । भले पाहोन करावे । शोधून मित्र ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रथम आपल्या अंगचे उत्तम गुण प्रगट करावें. आणि मगआपण कोणाशीही बोललो तरी त्याची किंमत होते. सज्जन माणसें पाहून त्यांच्याशी स्नेह जोडावा.
owis.englishMeaning: That pure sattwa guna should become apparent and then this `speech' will be present wherever and with whosoever you may be with. The wise (ie. Witness) therefore should be searched out and understood and made a friend.

owis.original: उपासनेसारिखें बोलावें । सर्व जनासी तोषवावें । सगट बरेंपण राखावें । कोण्हीयेकासी ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उपासनेला शोभेल असेंच बोलाचें. सर्व लोकांना संतुष्ट करावें. सरसगट सर्व लोकांशी चांगलें संबंध ठेवावेत.
owis.englishMeaning: Your worship should be this `speech' and this worship should make the people happy (maharaj- when you are happy the whole world is happy). Then within this lumped together world of so `many' things, thoughtlessness should be protected by that One who is within everyone.

owis.original: ठाईं ठाईं शोध घ्यावा । मग ग्रामीं प्रवेश करावा । प्राणीमात्र बोलवावा । आप्तपणें ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या गावांत जायचे त्या गावाबद्दल आधीं माहिती मिळवावी. मग त्या गावांत जावें. गांवांतील लोकांना आपलेपणानें स्वतःकडे बोलवावें.
owis.englishMeaning: This place of the `all' should be searched out and one should enter and stay there. When the entire prana resounds with this thought `I am' then, everywhere belongs to you.

owis.original: उंच नीच म्हणों नये । सकळांचें निववावें हृदये । अस्तमानीं जाऊं नये । कोठें तर्‍ही ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्याकडे आलेल्या लोकांमधे उच्च नीच, श्रेष्ठ कनिष्ठ, असा भेद करुं नये. सगळ्यांचे अंतःकरण शांत करावें. सूर्यास्त झाल्यावर उगीच कोठेंतरी जाऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: That highest and ever constant paramatma should say nothing to this world and then, the heart of this `all' will be made peaceful. Then one should not go anywhere where the dark night of ignorance has come.

owis.original: जगामधें जगमित्र । जिव्हेपासीं आहे सूत्र । कोठें तर्‍ही सत्पात्र । शोधून काढावें ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगांत जगन मित्र व्हायचे असेल तर त्याचे वर्म आपल्या जिभेपाशी आहे. आपण कोठेंही गेलो तरी तेथें उत्तम माणसें शोधून काढावीत.
owis.englishMeaning: Within this world of ignorance there is the friend of this world. This is the `all' connection at the source. The true and worthy recipient of knowledge should search out and take this.

owis.original: कथा होती तेथें जावें । दुरी दीनासारिखें बैसावें । तेथील सकळ हरद्र घ्यावें । अंतर्यामीं ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जेथें कथा होत असेल तेथें आपण जावें. पण नम्रतेनें सामान्यासारखें अगदी दूर बसावें. त्या कथेंमधील सर्व रहस्य आपल्या अंतरी घ्यावें.
owis.englishMeaning: There should be this `story' and then one can go near `there' and sit humbly at a distance (ie. witnessing). Then this `all' will be able to accept the inner meaning that is within `there'.

owis.original: तेथें भले आडळती । व्यापक ते हि कळों येती । हळुहळु मंदगती । रीग करावा ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या समुदायामधें भली माणसें आढळतात. व्यापक किंवा विशाल मनाचें कोण आहे तेंहि कळतें. अशा रीतीनें हळुहळु गावांतील लोकांत शिरकाव करुन घ्यावा.
owis.englishMeaning: `There' is where the wise is met. `There' the one who pervades (ie. atma purush) and that Reality can be understood. Therefore gradually, `there' should be entered.

owis.original: सकळांमधें विशेष श्रवण । श्रवणाहुनी थोर मनन । मननें होये समाधान । बहुत जनाचें ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्व उपायांमधे विशेष असेल तर तें श्रवण होय. पण श्रवणापेक्षा मनन श्रेष्ठ आहे. मननामुळें पुष्कळ लोकांचे समाधान होतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Within this `all', shravan is most important. Greater than this shravan/listening, is *manana. For when there is manana then, this `all' within the people can get complete contentment. *(manana means to continuously hold this `all' in the mind)

owis.original: धूर्तपणें सकळ जाणावें । अंतरीं अंतर बाणावें । समजल्याविण सिणावें । कासयासी ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चाणाक्षपणें सर्व गोष्टी समजून घ्याव्या. आपल्या अंतःकरणांत दुसर्‍याच्या अंतःकरणाची बरोबर कल्पना असावी. कोणतीही गोष्ट समजल्याखेरीज उगीच श्रम करणें म्हणजे स्वतःला उगीच शिणवणें होय.
owis.englishMeaning: By being very astute, this `all' will be known and then only this inner space should be accepted in your inner space (ie. no other thoughts other than this `I am' should be accepted by this `I am'). Tell me, why should one fruitlessly toil, without this under- standing? .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Karant Lakshan Nirupan (A Discourse on the Attributes of the Unfortunate)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: सुचित करुनी अंतःकर्ण । ऐका करंटलक्षण । हें त्यागितां सदेवलक्षण । आंगीं बाणे ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतःकरण एकाग्र करुन करंट्याची लक्षणें ऐकावीत.त्यांचा त्याग केल्यानें भाग्यवानाची लक्षणें अंगी बाणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Listen and then that attention of the miserable fool will be made into this alert antah-karana (that only knows). When you abandon this attention of the miserable fool then, this *wise attention within the `all' body will be accepted (nothing needs to be done; only the chattering of the mind has to be left off and then that which naturally remains can be accepted). *(lit. That is with God)

owis.original: पापाकरितां दरिद्र प्राप्त । दरिद्रें होये पापसंचित । ऐसेंचि होत जात । क्षणक्षणा ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पापाचे आचरण झाल्यानें दारिद्र्य प्राप्त होते. दातिद्र्यानें पाप सांठत जाते. असें एकामुळें एक सारखें होत जाते.
owis.englishMeaning: Because you have taken yourself to be a body, there is poverty (for real wealth is to know your Self). And due to this poverty, there are the *sins of accumulated karma. And due to this karma, this wise attention comes and goes every moment (this wise attention that just knows ie. pure sattwa guna, has become rajo guna. Then you have to forget the object you just seen to know the next object or you have to forget the word you just heard to know the next word etc. Therefore this knowing of something is always followed by the forgetting of it and this is not the attention of the wise). *(maharaj the only sin is "I am the body")

owis.original: याकारणें करंटलक्षणें । ऐकोनी त्यागचि करणें । म्हणिजे कांहीं येक बाणे । सदेवलक्षण ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून करंटलक्षणें ऐकून त्यांचा त्याग करावा. असा त्याग केला म्हणजें कांहीं भाग्यलक्षणें अंगीं बाणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this `speech' there has come this attention of the miserable fool (ie. this `speech' is knowledge. But this knowledge is also ignorance of your Reality. And when these two mix together they bring the rajo guna and a world of `many' forms gets created). This action is simply listening and it is the giving up this attention of the fool (ie. by simply listening or knowing, ones attention upon the `many' objects is given up. Mind has understood, "These objects are only imagined; they have been created by my thoughts and now I don't want them"). But this means that, the One who is within this `thing' has accepted this wise attention as Its own Self (ie. He takes this knowledge as the Truth).

owis.original: करंट्यास आळस आवडे । यत्न कदापि नावडे । त्याची वासना वावडे । अधर्मीं सदा ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: करंट्याला आळस आवडतो. प्रयत्न करणें कधींच आचडत नाही. त्याची वासना नेहमी अधर्मांत वावरते.
owis.englishMeaning: The miserable like to be lazy. They never like to make such effort. Then this vasana of the atma that simply wants to be is always wandering around in adharma (ie. your dharma is to be this `I am'. This requires tremendous effort to always remain detached and throw off this world of thoughts; adharma is to be the body and then you want to know so many things)3

owis.original: सदा भ्रमिष्ट निदसुरा । उगेंचि बोले सैरावैरा । कोणीयेकाच्या अंतरा । मानेचिना ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो नेहमी भ्रमिष्ट व झोपाळू असतो. तो उगीच अव्वाच्यासव्वा बोलतो. कोणाच्याही अंतःकरणाला मानीत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that eternal is confused and sleepy and that still and silent Self speaks without rhyme or reason; and this inner space of that One who is within everyone is not valued.

owis.original: लेहों नेणे वाचूं नेणे । सवदासुत घेऊं नेणे । हिशेब कितेब राखों नेणे। धारणा नाहीं ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याला लिहीणें वाचणें येत नाही. व्यापारांत करावें लागणारे देणेघेणें येत नाहीं. जमाकहर्च लिहीतां येत नाही. त्याच्या लक्षांतहि कांहीं राहात नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Then He does not know how to `write' this story of God nor how to `read' it either (ie. be the Witness); He does not know what to take from this market place (ie. this `I am' within should be taken from this market place we call the world). If He does not know how to keep regard for this `story'; for He has no fortitude.

owis.original: हारवी सांडी पाडी फोडी । विसरे चुके नाना खोडी । भल्याचे संगतीची आवडी । कदापी नाहीं ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो वस्तू हारवतो, सांडतो, पाडतो, फोडतो, विसरतो व चुकतो. या वअशा इतर खोडी त्याच्या अंगी असतात. चांगल्या माणसाची संगत धरण्याची त्याला मुळींच आवड नसतें.
owis.englishMeaning: He loses, spoils, breaks or makes to tumble, this `all'. He forgets Himself and makes the mistakes of `many' bad habits. He has no liking for the company of the wise.

owis.original: चाट गडी मेळविले । कुकर्मी मित्र केले । खट नट येकवटिले । चोरटे पापी ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो चावट सोबती मिळवितो. वाईट कृत्यें करण्यासाठीं मित्र जमा करतो. अशा रीतीनें दुष्ट, नष्ट,चोरटे व पापी लोक आपल्याभोवती जमा करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: He collects around him the talkative and makes friends with impure actions. He gathers the mischief-monger, the rogue and cheat, robber and sinner (the mind).

owis.original: ज्यासीं त्यासीं कळकटा । स्वयें सदाचा चोरटा । परघातकी धाटामोटा । वाटा पाडी ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याच्यात्याच्याशी त्याची तक्रार, भांडण असते. स्वतः नेहमी चोरटा असतो. त्याचप्रमाणें दुसर्‍याचा घात करणारा, आडदांड व वाटमारेपणा करणारा असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: He quarrels with that purush and that paramatma. He is dishonest with that natural and eternal Self. He is very disrespectful and very capable of obstructing the proper way.

owis.original: दीर्घ सूचना सुचेचिना । न्याय नीति हे रुचेना । परअभिळासीं वासना । निरंतर ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याला दुरदर्शीपणा मुळींच नसतो. न्याय व नीति आवडत नाहीं. दुसर्‍याचे लुबाडावें हींच वासना त्याला नेहमी असते.
owis.englishMeaning: This continuous understanding does not occur to his mind. He does not like thou- ghtlessness or justice and equanimity. That eternal brahman has become the desire to covet another.

owis.original: आळसें शरीर पाळिलें । परंतु पोटेंविण गेलें । सुडकें मिळेनासें जालें । पांघराया ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असा करंटा माणूस केवळ आळसानें आपलें शरीर पाळतो. त्याचा परिणाम असा होतो कीं, काळांतरानें त्याला खायला अन्न मिळत नाहीं. आणि पांघरायला पांढरें फडके देखील मिळत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to such *laziness, the body is obeyed. Still He cannot take his belly with him when He dies and He will not even have a cloth to cover himself on the funeral pyre (He who is without a body takes a body as Himself). *(Such laziness means doing many things but not doing that which he should do ie. seek the Self)

owis.original: आळसें शरीर पाळी । अखंड कुंसी कांडोळी । निद्रेचे पाडी सुकाळीं । आपणासी ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा आळशीपणानें शरीर सांभाळणारा करंटा सारखा कुशी खाजवतो. नाहींतर आरामांत झोपून राहातो.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to laziness, He pampers and protects the body. That unbroken Self then scratches his belly (thinks of satisfying that only) and his favourite time is that of sleep.

owis.original: जनासीं मीत्री करीना । कठीण शब्द बोले नाना । मूर्खपणें आवरेना । कोणीयेकासी ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो लोकांशी स्नेह जोडीत नाहीं. ज्याला त्याला तो कठोर व लागणारे शब्द बोलतो. स्वतःच्या मूर्खपणामुळें तो कोणासहि आवरला जात नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: He does not make friends with the people (ie. mind compares and creates enmity for he sees everyone as different to himself). His `speech' is the harsh words of the `many' and due to his foolishness there is not the control of that One who is within everybody. (The gentle word is `I am He' and the hard, harsh words are "I am the body", "Who are you to tell me" etc.)

owis.original: पवित्र लोकांमधें भिडावे । वोंगळामधें निशंक धांवे । सदा मनापासून भावे । जननिंद्य क्रिया ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पवित्र लोकांमधें जायला त्याला संकोच वाटतो. पण अपवित्र व घाणेरड्या लोकांमधे तो निःशंक वावरतो. लोक ज्या क्रियांना निंद्य मानतात त्या क्रिया करंट्याला मनापासून आवडतात.
owis.englishMeaning: He feels shy in the world of the pure, but shamelessly runs and mixes with the filthy. That eternal Self, due to these affections of the mind, even makes the actions abhorred by the people.

owis.original: तेथें कैचा परोपकार । केला बहुतांचा संव्हार । पापी अनर्थी अपस्मार । सर्वअबद्धी ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: करंट्यापाशीं परोपकाराचे नांवच काढायला नको. तो पुष्कळांना जीवें मारतो. तो पापी, अनर्थ घडवून आणणारा, लहरी आणि सर्व दृष्टीनीं असंबद्ध असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then how can there be that One `there' who uplifts this `all'? For He is a killer of this `all', a sinner (ie. body conscious), destructive and a great calamity. He is wilful ("I do") and foulmouthed to this `all'.

owis.original: शब्द सांभाळून बोलेना । आवरितां आवरेना । कोणीयेकासी मानेना । बोलणें त्याचें ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बोलतांना तो शब्द सामभाळून बोलत नाहीं. त्याचेबोलणें कोणी आवरु म्हटलें तर तें आवरलें जात नाहीं. व तेम बोलणें कोणालाच आवडणरे नसते.
owis.englishMeaning: He does not `speak' this `word' of comfort. He does not protect that which is to be protected and his talk has no respect for that One who is within everybody.

owis.original: कोणीयेकास विश्र्वास नाहीं । कोणीयेकासीं सख्य नाहीं । विद्या वैभव कांहींच नाहीं । उगाचि ताठा ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याचा कोणावर विश्र्वास नसतो. त्याचे कोणाशीं सख्य नसतें. विद्या, वैभव वगैरे कांहींसुद्धा बरोबर नसून अभिमान मात्र फार असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: He does not believe in that One within everybody. He has no friendship with that One within everybody. He does not have the glory of this knowledge of the `thing', for that still and silent Self has become filled with pride and arrogance.

owis.original: राखावीं बहुतांचीं अंतरें । भाग्य येतें तदनंतरें । ऐसीं हें विवेकाचीं उत्तरें । ऐकणार नाहीं ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुष्कळ लोकांचें अंतःकरण सांभाळले तर मग कालांतरानें भाग्य लाभतें. असे विवेकाचे बोल ऐकण्याची त्याची तयारी नसते.
owis.englishMeaning: This inner space should protect this `all' (this `I am' should be filled with `I am') and only then will good fortune/bhagya come. Then in thoughtlessness, even this `reply' of vivek will not be heard (ie. complete understanding will come).

owis.original: स्वयें आपणास कळेना । शिकविलें तें ऐकेना । तयासी उपाय नाना । काये करिती ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्याला स्वतःला कळत नाहीं आणि कोणी शिकवलें तर तें ऐकत नाहीं. अशा माणसाला कोणताच उपाय लागूं पडत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: The natural Self cannot understand *Its own Self (you are That; so if you think you have understood That which is beyond understanding then, you are understanding something else). And even if taught this `I am', still that Reality is not this `thing' that can be listened to. So then tell me, how can the `many' remedies be of any use in gaining that Reality? *(maharaj- if the mango says, `I am sweet' then, it cannot be a mango)

owis.original: कल्पना करी उदंड कांहीं । प्राप्तव्य तों कांहींच नाहीं । अखंड पडिला संदेहीं । अनुमानाचे ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो खूप मोठ्यामोठ्या कल्पना करतो. परंतु त्यातून त्याच्या पदरांत काहींच पडत नाहीं. तो कायमचा कल्पनांच्या जाळ्यांत अडकलेला राहतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That vast paramatma has imagined this `thing' though it does not even need this `thing' and afterwards that unbroken swarup fell into the conjecture of body consci- ousness.

owis.original: पुण्यमार्ग सांडिला मनें । पाप झडावें काशानें । निश्र्चय नाहीं अनुमानें । नास केला ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मनापासून पुण्य मार्गाचा त्यानें त्याग केल्यानें त्याचेपाप क्षीण होण्यास उपाय उरत नाहीं. त्याच्याजवळ कोणताही एक निश्र्चय नसतो. त्यामुळें केवळ अनुमानाच्यामुळें त्याचा नाश होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If the mind has left this path of merit (`I am') then, how can sin ever fade away? Then there is no conviction and there is only the conjecture that leads to your destruction.

owis.original: कांहींयेक पुर्ते कळेना । सबहेमधें बोलों राहेना । बाष्कळ लाबाड ऐसें जना । कळों आलें ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणतीही गोष्ट त्याला संपूर्णपणें व नीटपणें कळत नाहीं. पण तो सभेमधें कांहीमतरी बोलल्यावाचून राहात नाहीं. तो चावट आहे, लबाड आहे असे लोकांना समजते.
owis.englishMeaning: If that One within this `thing' has not got perfect understanding and in this meeting place, this `speech' has not been established; then the people come to know that he is frivolous and false (just like them).

owis.original: कांहीं नेमकपण आपुलें । बहुत जनासी कळों आलें । तेंचि मनुष्य मान्य जालें । भूमंडळीं ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या माणसाच्या जीवनांत कांहींतरी निश्र्चितपणाचें वागणें आढळते आणि तें पुष्कळ लोकांना कळतें, त्याच माणसाला जगांत मान्यता मिळतें.
owis.englishMeaning: But if this `thing' is established with itself then, there is the understanding that the people are myself. And then only does one become something that is worthy of being honoured in the world.

owis.original: झिजल्यावांचुनी कीर्ति कैंची । मान्यता नव्हे कीं फुकाची । जिकडे तिकडे होते ची ची । अवलक्षणें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शरीरानें, मनाने व पैशानें झिजल्यावाचून जगांत कीर्ति मिळत नाहीं. जगाकडून मान्यता कांहीं फुकट प्राप्त होत नाहीं.ज्याच्या अंगीं कुलक्षणें असतात त्याची जिकडे तिकडे छी थू होतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Without taking great efforts how can there be such pervasiveness? However how can such honour and respect come free? But due to this impure attention of body consciousness there is disgrace and ridicule everywhere (even if you gain honour and respect in this life still there are those who will ridicule you; and old age is full of disgrace and ridicule for all).

owis.original: भल्याची संगती धरीना । आपणासी शाहाणे करीना । तो आपला आपण वैरी जाणा । स्वहित नेणे ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो माणूस चांगल्याची संगत धरीत नाहीं, तो स्वतःला शाहाणा करीत नाहीं. तो स्वतःचे हित जाणीत नाहीं. तो स्वतःच आपला वैरी होतो हें ओळखावें.
owis.englishMeaning: By not holding to the company of the wise, wisdom cannot come to you. When that atma does not know how to care for Its own welfare then, you have become your own worst enemy.

owis.original: लोकांसी बरें करावें । तें उसिणें सवेंचि घ्यावें । ऐसें जयाच्या जीवें । जाणिजेना ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण लोकांचें चांगलें केलें तर लोकही आपलें चांगलें करतात, ही गोष्ट करंट्याच्या जीवाला कळतच नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: The wise should make this world beyond (ie. sagun) and one should gratefully accept this `all' as the returns for one's efforts (ie. vivek; make vivek and then accept this `fruit of your labour' that will come of its own accord). In this way, the jiva of this mula maya will not be known.

owis.original: जेथें नाहीं उत्तम गुण । तें करंटपणाचें लक्षण । बहुतांसीं न मने तें अवलक्षण । सहजचि जालें ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सारांश ज्याच्याजवळ एकही उत्तम गुण नाहीं त्याच्यापाशी करंटेपण आहे असें समजावें. जें पुष्कळांना आवडत नाहीं ते सहजच अवलक्षण मानलें जातें.
owis.englishMeaning: Where `here' is not that best guna then, that Reality has the attention of misfortune and poverty. When this `all' is not present because of the wandering mind, then that natural and attentionless Self becomes the impure attention of the jiva.

owis.original: कार्याकारण सकळ कांहीं । कार्येविण तों कांहींच नाहीं । निकामी तो दुःखप्रवाहीं । वाहातचि गेला ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कामाच्या निमित्यानें सगळे लोक एकमेकांना विचारतात. कामाशिवाय कोणी कोणाला विचारत नाहीं. म्हणून जो माणूस कोणत्याही कामास उपयोगी पडत नाहीं तो दुःखाच्या प्रवाहांत वाहात जातो.
owis.englishMeaning: This one moving `action' and its cause (ie. knowing) are with this `all thing'. And without this `action', that paramatma and even this `thing' are not (ie. drowned in thoughts). That One who is lazy, surely falls in this river of sorrow and gets swept along downwards.

owis.original: बहुतांसीं मान्य थोडा । त्याच्या पापासी नाहीं जोडा । निराश्रई पडे उघडा । जेथें तेथें ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो पुष्कळांनां मान्य नसतो, आवडत नसतो त्याच्या पापाला जोड नाहीं. त्याला कोणी कोठेंच आश्रय देत नाहीं. तो सर्व ठिकाणीं उघडा पडतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The few that have respect for this `all' do not meet this sin of that atma (ie. where this open atma has become jivatma). And they are completely free and open `here' and `there' (ie. paramatma).

owis.original: याकारणें अवगुण त्यागावे । उत्तम गुण समजोन घ्यावे । तेणें मनासारिखें फावे । सकळ कांहीं ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून माणसानें आपलें अवगुण टाकावे. उत्तम जुण समजून अभ्यासावें. असें केलें तर सगळें कांहीं मनाप्रमाणें घडून येतें.
owis.englishMeaning: By means of this `speech', the wrong gunas should be given up and the best guna should be understood and accepted. Then that Reality experiences this `all thing' as His mind (maharaj- make your mind, the Masters mind). (maharaj- I am a Master of my mind) .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Sadev Lakshan Nirupan (A Discourse on the Attributes of the Godly)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: मागां बोलिलें करंटलक्षण । तें विवेकें सांडावें संपूर्ण । आतां ऐका सदेवलक्षण। परम सौख्यदायेक ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मागील समासांत करंट्याची लक्षणें सांगितलीं. विवेकानें ती संपूर्ण सोडावी. आतां अतिशय सुख देणारी सदेव लक्षणें सांगतों तीं ऐका.
owis.englishMeaning: Previous to this `speech' there is the attention of the miserable and impoverished jiva. That Reality should completely leave this through vivek. Now, if you listen with the attention that is with God (ie. forget everything; the natural guna) then, there will be that Supreme, the giver of happiness.

owis.original: उपजतगुण शरीरीं । परोपकारी नानापरी । आवडे सर्वांचे अंतरीं । सर्वकाळ ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याच्या अंगीं कांहीं गुण उपजत असतात, तो अनेक मार्गांनी परोपकार करतो. आणि जो सर्वकाळ सर्वांना आवडतो तो सदेव होय.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is this naturally acquired guna* of this `all' body then, the ways of the `many' will become that atma. Therefore one should always have fondness for this `all' within your inner space (He is content to know Himself only). *(The new born child is in this sattwa guna; it does not know anything other than `I am')

owis.original: सुंदर अक्षर लेहों जाणे । चपळ शुद्ध वाचूं जाणे । अर्थांतर सांगो जाणे । सकळ कांहीं ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो सुंदर अक्षर लिहीतो. भरभर पण शुद्ध वाचतो. आणि तो जें वाचतो त्याचा सगळा व सखोल अर्थ सांगू शकतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That indestructible Self knows how to `write' beautifully and He knows how to *`read' quickly and without error. That purush understands the meaning of this `all thing' within His inner space. *(As one `writes' one is naturally `reading'/witnessing)

owis.original: कोणाचे मनोगत तोडीना । भल्यांची संगती सोडीना । सदेवलक्षण अनुमाना । आणून ठेवी ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो कोणाचे मन मोडित नाहीं. चांगल्यांची संगत सोडित नाहीं. भग्यवंताच्या लक्षणांची त्याला बरोबर कल्पना असते.
owis.englishMeaning: The one who never breaks this inner intent to know, never leaves the company of the wise. This wish attention that is with God should be brought and placed upon any conjecture.

owis.original: तो सकळ जनासी व्हावा । जेथें तेथें नित्य नवा । मूर्खपणें अनुमानगोवा । कांहींच नाहीं. ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्वांना तो हवाहवासा वाटतो. जेथें जेथें तो जातो तेथें तेथें तो नवीनपणानें लोकांना आवडतो. म्हणजे त्याची लोकप्रियता वाढतच जाते. मूर्खपणामुळें उत्पन्न होणारा कल्पनेचा घोटाळा त्याच्याजवळ नसतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Your mind should be this union of purush and prakruti and everywhere should be always ever new. However when there is foolishness, there is only the entanglement of conjecture and no `thing'.

owis.original: नाना उत्तम गुण सत्पात्र । तेचि मनुष्य जगमित्र । प्रगट कीर्ति स्वतंत्र । पराधेन नाहीं ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक उत्तम गुणांचें स्थान असणारा म्हणून तो सत्पात्र असतो. असा मनुष्य खरा जगमित्र असतो. त्याची कीर्ति त्याच्या गुणांच्या योगानें स्वतंत्ररित्या जगांत पसरते. त्याच्या कीर्तिला कोणाचा आधार लागत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When these `many' gunas become a worthy recipient of that best guna, then that man becomes a friend of the world. Then pervasiveness and independence manifest and He requires no support.

owis.original: राखे सकळांचे अंतर । उदंड करी पाठांतर । नेमस्तपणाचा विसर । पडणार नाहीं ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो सर्वांचें अंतःकरण सांभालतो. त्याचें पाठांतर खूप असते. नियमितआचरणाचा त्याला कधीच विसर पडत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: That vast paramatma is the supporter and protector of this inner space of the `all'. When His limitation (ie. to be a jiva) is forgotten then, He will never come tumbling down into the body.

owis.original: नम्रपणें पुसों जाणे । नेमस्त अर्थ सांगो जाणे । बोलाऐसें वर्तो जाणे । उत्तम क्रिया ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याचें कोणास कांहीं विचारणें नम्रपणाचे असते. ग्रंथाचा बरोबर नेमका अर्थ कसा सांगावा हे तो जाणतो.जसें तो बोलतों तसें तो चालतो. आणि त्याच्या हातून नेहमी उत्तम क्रियाच घडतात.
owis.englishMeaning: He knows how to wipe out everything with His humility (I know nothing) and then He knows the innermost meaning of this `word' and tells that only. He only knows the best *`action' that functions through like this `speech'. *(chaitanya)

owis.original: जो मानला बहुतांसी । कोणी बोलों न शके त्यासी । धगधगीत पुण्यरासी । माहांपुरुष ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याला पुष्कळ लोक मानतात. म्हणून त्याला कोणी उगीच कांहीहि बोलूं शकत नाहीं. तो मोठा तेजस्वी व पुण्यवान महापुरुष असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That purush respects this `all' and `speaks' to no other. He is the great purush from whom shines an abundance of merit.

owis.original: तो परोपकार करितांचि गेला । पाहिजे तो ज्याला त्याला । मग काये उणें तयाला। भूमंडळीं ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो अविरत परोपकार करीत जातो. या कारणानें ज्याला त्याला तो हवासा वाटतो.अशा परोपकारी पुरुषाला या जगांत कांहींच कमी पडत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When that atma purush is doing then, that wants only to be with Himself. Then what does He lack for in the world?

owis.original: बहुत जन वाट पाहे । वेळेसी तत्काळ उभा राहे । उणें कोणाचें न साहे । तया पुरुषासी ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुष्कळ लोक त्याची वाट पाहातात. आणि तो देखिल प्रत्येकाच्या अडचणीच्या वेळीं मदत करण्यासाठीं उभा राहतो. त्या महापुरुषाला कोणाचेहि उणे पडलेले सहन होत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When the mind waits expectantly saying, "Let whatever has to come, come," then this `all' is understood. And at that time that purush comes to the assistance of this mind (when you don't care, then the Self takes care).4 And then there is that Reality, That does not tolerate even this fault of the `all' that is with the purush.

owis.original: चौदा विद्या चौसष्टी कला । जाणे संगीत गायेनकळा । आत्मविद्येचा जिव्हाळा । उदंड तेथें ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याच्यापाशी चौदा विद्या व चौसष्ट कला असतात. तो संगीत जाणतो. स्वतः गाऊं शकतो. त्याच्या अंतर्यामीं आत्मविद्येविषयीं अतिशय जिव्हाळा असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: He knows the fourteen learnings and the sixty-four arts and He knows the art of `singing and dance' (`I am and I move everything, everywhere'). He is the source of this knowledge of atma and that vast paramatma `there'. (When that atma is the Knower of this `all' then, that One atma gets called purush or antar-atma or shivatma. When that atma has the `many' worldly knowledges then, it gets called jivatma. And when He does not know even ie. when the knowledge dissolves within Him, then He gets called paramatma. But whether in duality or non-duality still, He is One)

owis.original: सकळांसी नम्र बोलणें । मनोगत राखोन चालणें । अखंड कोणीयेकाचें उणें । पडोंचि नेदी ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्वांशीं तो नम्रपणें बोलतो. दुसर्‍याच्या मनांतलें ओळखून वागतो. केव्हांहि तो कोणाचे उणे पडूं देत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: He makes this humble `speech' to the `all' and He protects and moves this inner intent. That unbroken One within everyone should never be allowed to fall into the incomplete.

owis.original: न्याय नीति भजन मर्यादा । काळ सार्थक करी सदा । दरिद्रपणाची आपदा । तेथें कैची ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: न्याय, नीति, भजन, मर्यादा सांभाळून तो आपला काळ सार्थकीं लावतो. अशा माणसाच्या जीवनांत दारिद्र्याचे संकट येणें अशक्य असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is respect for bhajans, justice and equanimity then, His `time' is used to seek out the meaning of life.5 How can the adversity of poverty be `there'? (`Time' is this `now'; and within this ever present moment there is that `timeless' Reality)

owis.original: उत्तमगुणें श्रृंघारला । तो बहुतामधें शोभला । प्रगट प्रतापें उगवला । मार्तंड जैसा ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा प्रकारच्या उत्तम गुणांनी शृमगारलेला तो पुरुष पुष्कळांच्यामध्यें शोभून दिसतो. सूर्य जसा उगवला कीं, त्याचा प्रखर प्रकाश पडतो, त्याचप्रमाणें अशा पुरुषाचे तेज पडते.
owis.englishMeaning: When He is embellished with that best guna, then that atma within this `all' shines. Then His majesty becomes evident and He shines like the sun.

owis.original: जाणता पुरुष असेल जेथें । कळ्हो कैचा उठेल तेथें । उत्तम गुणाविषीं रितें । तें प्राणी करंटे ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या ठिकाणीं शहाणा पुरुष असतो त्या ठिकाणी भांडणतंटा होत नाहीं.ज्यांच्यापाशीं उत्तम गुण नसतात तें लोक करंटे असतात. त्यांच्यापाशीं भांडणतंटे होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When `here' is that knowing purush then, how can any disagreement arise `there'? But when devoid of that best guna then, that Reality becomes a wretched and destitute fool in the prana (with the mixed gunas).

owis.original: प्रपंची जाणे राजकारण । परमार्थी साकल्य विवरण । सर्वांमधें उत्तम गुण । त्याचा भोक्ता ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उत्तम पुरुष प्रपंचांत व्यवहारचातुर्य जाणतो. आणि परमार्थांत आत्मानात्मविवेक आणि सारासार विचार जाणतो. सगळ्यांत जो उत्तम आढळेल त्याचा तो रसिक असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: In His worldly life, He knows rajakarana (`I do nothing, He does everything') and in His spiritual life, He has investigated that nirgun. He is that best guna within the `all' and He is the enjoyer of all things.

owis.original: मागें येक पुढें येक । ऐसा कदापी नाहीम दंडक । सर्वत्रांसीं अलोलिक । तया पुरुषाची ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मागें एक व पुढें एक असा दुटप्पी वर्तनाचा प्रघात त्याच्यापाशीं नसतो. म्हणून सगळ्यांना त्या पुरुषाचे मोठे कौतुक वाटते.
owis.englishMeaning: When that One is behind and that One is ahead then, traditions/customs can never exist there. Then everywhere is the wonder of that purush.

owis.original: अंतरासी लागेल ढका । ऐसी वर्तणूक करुं नका । जेथें तेथें विवेका । प्रगट करी ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणाचेहि अंतकरण दुखावेल असें तो कधीहि वागत नाहीं. प्रत्येक प्रसंगी वागण्यांत तो विवेक प्रगट करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not live a life where troubles touch this inner space. One should make vivek evident `here' and `there'.

owis.original: कर्मविधी उपासनाविधी । ज्ञानविधी वैराग्याविधी । विशाळ ज्ञात्रुत्वाची बुद्धी । चळेल कैसी ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कर्म, उपासना, ज्ञान आणि वैराग्य हीं चारहि त्याच्या ठिकाणीं अगदी योग्य पद्धतीनें आढलतात. जाणतेपणाची त्याची बुद्धि मोठी विशाल असते. ती कधीं चुकत नाहीं, चळत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is this way of action (`He does everything'), the way of worship (`He is everywhere'), the way of knowledge (`He knows') and the way of vairagya (`He wants nothing from this world'), then how can the buddhi of that vast Knower be obstructed?

owis.original: पाहातां अवघे उत्तम गुण । तयास वाईट म्हणेल कोण । जैसा आत्मा संपूर्ण । सर्वां घटीं ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसाच्याअंगीं असे उत्तम गुण दृष्टीस पडल्यावर मग त्याला कोणी वाईट म्हणत नाहीं. ज्याप्रमाणें सर्व देहांमध्यें आत्मा भरलेला आहे, त्याचप्रमाणें असा उत्तम पुरुष सर्वांच्या अंतःकरणांत प्रेमरुपानें आपलेपणानें भरुन राहतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When you understand that the `many' things are that best guna then, how can they be called the worst (objective things)? And when there is that complete atma then, this `all' body within the gross body, is That only (then this knowledge of the `all' is also let slip away).

owis.original: आपल्या कार्यास तत्पर । लोक असती लाहानथोर । तैसाचि करी परोपकार । मनापासुनी ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याप्रमाणें लहान मोठी माणसें आपापल्या कार्याला तत्पर असतात, त्याचप्रमाणें हा उत्तम पुरुष परोपकार करण्यास मनापासून तत्पर असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When He is absorbed in His own `action' then, that great brahman within this small jiva, is this world of the `all'. In this way, that atma works from Its universal mind.

owis.original: दुसर्‍याच्या दुःखें दुखते । दुसर्‍याच्या सुखें सुखावे । आवघेचि सुखी असावे । ऐसी वासना ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दुसर्‍याच्या दुःखानें तो दुःखी होतो तसाच दुसर्‍याच्या सुखानें तो सुखी होतो. जगांत सारे सुखी असावेत अशी त्याची मनापासून इच्छा असते.
owis.englishMeaning: One should suffer the sufferings of this `all' and one should enjoy the enjoyments of this `all'. But when there are the `many' things then, this vasana feels that there should only be pleasure (this vasana to be, meets pleasure and pain equally; but when body consciousness comes then, it seeks only to know pleasure).

owis.original: उदंड मुलें नानापरी । वडिलांचें मन अवघ्यांवरी । तैसी अवघ्यांची चिंता करी । माहांपुरुष ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समजा एखाद्याला बरीच मुलें आहेत. त्याचे लक्ष सगळ्या मुलांवर सारखेंच असते. त्याचप्रमाणें या महापुरुषाला सगळ्यांची काळजी असते.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the `many' kinds of children of that vast paramatma in this world then, the mind of that atma goes to the `many' things. And due to this, that great purush worries about everything. (When the `many' different things are born of the formless paramatma, then His mind that sees Himself only, starts objectifying and thinking about these objects)

owis.original: जयास कोणाचें सोसेना । तयाची निःकांचन वासना । धीकारिल्या धीकारेना । तोचि महापुरुष ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याला कोणाचे उणे सहन होत नाहीं. त्याला चूकुन कधी पैशाची वासना होत नाही. कोणी त्याचा धिक्कार केला तरी तो मनांत चळत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: If this `all' does not endure whatever comes then, this vasana of that atma becomes like a penniless beggar. But when one does not reproach the one who reproaches him, then he is that great purush who remains aloft. (If one meets this world without creating concepts; good, bad, pleasure, pain etc., and if one does not let anything trouble him then, body consciousness does not arise; and this is knowledge)

owis.original: मिथ्या शरीर निंद लें । तरी याचें काये गेलें । ज्ञात्यासी आणि जिंतिलें । देहबुद्धीनें ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या शरीराला तो मिथ्या समजतो. म्हणून कोणी त्याची निंदा केली तरी तो ती देहापुरती आहे या खात्रीनें स्वस्थ राहतो. जो खरा ज्ञाता आहे त्याला देहबुद्धि जिंकु शकत नाहीं. मी आत्माच आहे हें खरें ज्ञातेपणाचे लक्षण आहे. मी देहच आहे हें देहबुद्धिचें लक्षण आहे. दोन्ही एकमेकांच्या विरुद्ध असल्यानें एक असेल तेथें दुसरें असूं शकत नाहीं. म्हणून ज्ञात्याला देहाची निंदा स्पर्श करुं शकत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: He understands, "This false body has been insulted. Still, how has this `speech' been spoiled?" How can someone with body consciousness defeat that Knower? (He is forever aloft to the affairs of the world; one accepts insult only if the thought, "I have been insulted" arises in the mind. He does not feel insulted for that thought is not there)

owis.original: हें अवघें अवलक्षण । ज्ञाता देहीं विलक्षण । कांहीं तर्‍ही उत्तम गुण । जनीं दाखवावे ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहबुद्धि हे सगळें अवलक्षण समजावें. ज्ञाता पुरुष देहामध्यें असला तरी तो देहापासून अलिप्त असतो. विलक्षणपणें देहांत राहतो. देहांत विदेहीपणें राहतो. सारांश माणसानें लोकांमधें कांहीं तरी उत्तम गुण प्रगट करावे.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to the `many' things, that thoughtless paramatma has become the impure attention of the jiva. But that Knower within the body is quite different. Therefore that best guna within the people should reveal this `thing'.

owis.original: उत्तम गुणास मनुष्य वेधे । वाईट गुणासी प्राणी खेदे । तीक्ष्ण बुद्धि लोक साधे । काये जाणती ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उत्तम गुण पाहून माणसें आकर्षिली जातात. वाईट गुणाची माणसें लोकांना दुःख देतात. जाणत्या माणसाच्या अंगीं असलेल्या तीक्ष्ण बुद्धिची कल्पना सामान्य लोकांना येत नाहीं. देहबुद्धि नाहींशी करुन उत्तम गुणांची जोपासना करण्यासाठीं ज्ञानी पुरुषास तीक्ष्ण व सूक्ष्म बुद्धि लागते.
owis.englishMeaning: Man obstructs that best guna and then these worst gunas (ie. mixed gunas that bring objectification) bring sorrow in the prana. Tell me, what can that Knower accomplish with even a sharp buddhi of someone who thinks he is a body? (Even those considered very smart in this world are beggars ie. slaves to the mind)

owis.original: लोकीं अत्यंत क्षमा करिती । आलियां लोकांचे प्रचिती । मग ते लोक पाठी राखती । नाना प्रकारीं ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: थोर पुरुष लोकांचे अन्याय व अपराध यांना क्षमा करतो. जो पुरुष असा अत्यंत क्षमाशील असतो, त्याच्या क्षमेचा प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव आला म्हणजे मग लोक अनेक प्रकारें त्याच्या पाठीशी उभे राहतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When that antar-atma is very patient in this world of the `all' then, He meets Himself within this `experience'. Afterwards that Reality is the support and protector of this `all' world (ie. then that Reality uses knowledge to stay in the world).

owis.original: बहुतांस वाटे मी थोर । सर्वमान्य पाहिजे विचार । धीर उदार गंभीर । माहांपुरुष ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण थोर आहोत असें पुष्कळांना वाटते. पण सर्व लोक ज्याला थोर म्हणतात तोच खरा थोर असतो. महापुरुष सदैव धीर, उदार व गंभीर असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: But if this `all' feels, `I am the greatest' then, this respected `all' still requires that thoughtless understanding (I do not exist). Patience, boldness, openness and thought- fulness all belong to the great purush.

owis.original: जितुके कांहीं उत्तम गुण । तें समर्थाचें लक्षण । अवगुण तें करंटलक्षण । सहजचि जालें ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जेवढें उत्तम गुण आहेत ते समर्थ पुरुषाचे लक्षण समजावें. मग अवगुण हें करंट्याचे लक्षण हें सहजच ठरते.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is this `thing' of that best guna then, there can be the attention of the *Master. But where there are the impure gunas, then that Reality becomes the attention of the miserable and impoverished jiva. *(He uses knowledge to stay in this world) .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Dehe Manya Nirupan (A Discourse on Regard for the Body)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: मातीचे देव धोंड्याचे देव । सोन्याचे देव रुप्याचे देव । काशाचे देव पितळेचे देव । तांब्याचे देव चित्रलेपे ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव कसलेले बनवतात? माती, दगड, सोनें, चांदी, कासें, पितळ च तांबें यांपासून देव बनवतात. कांहीं देव रंगाच्या लेपानें केलेले असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the gods made of earth, the gods of stone, the gods of gold, the gods of silver, the gods of bronze, the gods of brass, the gods of copper and also painted pictures of gods.

owis.original: रुविच्या लांकडाचे देव पोंवळ्यांचे देव । बाण तांदळे नर्मदे देव । शालिग्रा, काश्मिरी देव । सूर्यकांत सोमकांत ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कांहीं देव रुईच्या लाकडाचे तर कांहीं देव पोवळ्याचे असतात. शिवाय तांदळे, नर्मदे,शाळीग्राम, स्फटिकाचे देव, सूर्यकांत, व सोमकांत हे देव आहेतच.
owis.englishMeaning: There are gods of cotton, of wood and of coral; there are the stones from the river narmada and they are smeared with red paint and called gods; there are the gods of the shaligram stones and kashmiri stones and the stones called suryakant and somakant.

owis.original: तांब्रनाणीं हेमनाणीं । कोणी पूजिती देवार्चनीं । चक्रांगीत चक्रतीर्थाहुनी । घेऊन येती ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कांहीं जण तांब्याच्या व सोन्याच्या नाण्यांची पूजा करतात. कांहीं लोक चक्रतीर्थाहून चक्रांकित दगड आणतात व देव म्हणून त्यांची पूजा करतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Some people do their puja with coins of copper and gold and make offerings to them. Some people go on a pilgrimage to chakrateerth and bring back the stones called chakrankita.

owis.original: उदंड उपासनेचे भेद । किती करावे विशद । आपलाले आवडीचा वेध । लागला जनीं ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवांच्याप्रमाणें उपासनेचे देखील पुष्कळ प्रकार आहेत. ते सगळे कसें सांगणार? लोकांना आपापल्या आवडीच्या देवाचे आकर्षण असते.
owis.englishMeaning: In this world there is that vast paramatma and there are these `many' different kinds of worship. Therefore those who make these `many' forms of worship should understand thoughtlessness. However, in this world, people are attracted by their own likings.

owis.original: परी त्या सकळांचें हि कारण । मुळीं पाहावें स्मरण । तया स्मरणाचे अंश जाण । नाना देवतें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पण या सगळ्या देवांचे कारण एकच आहे. तें म्हणजे अगदी मुळामधें झालेला स्मरणरुप संकल्प होय. निरनिराळे देव या स्मरणाचे लहानमोठे अंश आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: But the cause of this `all' (ie. the knowing of this known) should be understood at the root and remembered (ie. this union of the purush and prakruti bring this knowing and this should be carefully investigated and remembered by forgetting everything else). And know that when there is the worship of the `many' deities then, only a part of that Reality is being remembered (this is rajo guna, the guna of the waking state; knowledge is there but it gets followed by ignorance. This knowledge part therefore needs to be understood and made to expand).

owis.original: मुळीं द्रष्टा देव तो येक । त्याचे जाहाले अनेक । समजोन पाहातां विवेक । उमजों लागे ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अगदी मूळचा द्रष्टा देव एकच आहे. यापासून हे अनेक देव झाले. विवेकानें शोधून पाहिलें तर हें समजेल.
owis.englishMeaning: At the root there is the Knower and that One is called God (ie. purush). But if there is the foolishness and passions of that One then, there are the numerous different shapes. Only when one starts to understand vivek can these things be understood and known.

owis.original: देह्यावेगळी भक्ति फावेना । देह्यावेगळा देव पावेना । याकारणें मूळ भजना । देहेचि आहे ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहाच्या साधनाखेरीज भक्ति करतां येत नाहीं. देहाच्या साधनाखेरीज देव पावत नाहीं. यावरुन असें स्पष्ट दिसतें कीं, देह हाच देवाच्या भजनाचें मूळ आहे. देवाची भक्ति असो वा दर्शन असो ते घडण्यास देह हें एकच साधन आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Devotion cannot be made without the body and God cannot be realized without the body. For it is due to the body and on account of this `speech', that the root of this whole creation is come upon. And it is this understanding that should be called bhajan (bhajan means to be this root; there the purush resides as the witness of His prakruti; there is the source of this `speech', `I only am').

owis.original: देहे मुळींच केला वाव । तरी भजनासी कैंचा ठाव । म्हणोनी भजनाचा उपाव । देह्यात्मयोगें ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहाला संपूर्ण मिथ्या मानलें तर मग भजनाला जागाच उरत नाहीं. अंतरात्म्याचा देहाशी संयोग घडतोम्हणून माणूस भजन करुं लागतो.
owis.englishMeaning: But it is also because of this body that this root has been made useless and then, how can there be this place of bhajan? (If being this body is seen as the goal in itself then, God will not be searched for and He will be as if not there). Therefore understand this remedy called bhajan that is performed by that atma in the company of the body. (Without that atma, the body can do nothing and without the body, the atma can do nothing. He may not be seen but He is inferred and it is due to Him that the bhajan can be made and it is He who is the goal)

owis.original: देहेंविण देव कैसा भजावा । देहेंविण देव कैसा पुजावा । देह्याविण मोहछाव कैसा करावा । कोण्या प्रकारें ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देह नसेल तर देवाला भजता येणार नाहीं. देह नसेल तर देवाची पूजा करतां येणार नाहीं. देह नसेल तर देवाचा महोत्सव करतां येणार नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Without the body and this God, how can this bhajan be accomplished? Without the body and this God, how can there be this puja/worship? And without the body, who can make this great celebration of God (ie. `I am')?

owis.original: अत्र गंध पत्र पुष्प । फल तांबोल धूप दीप । नाना भजनाचा साक्षेप । कोठें करावा ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अत्तर, गंध, पत्र, पुष्प, फल, तांबोोल, धूप, दीप वगैरे अनेक भजनाचे, पूजनाचे विधी देहाच्या अभावी करतां येणार नाहींत.
owis.englishMeaning: There may be the beautiful scents, sandalwood paste, leaves, flowers, fruits, pan (ie. betel-leaf), incense and lamps; but how can these `many' things be this dedication to bhajan? (How can one remember that swarup in every action when there is the making of the tradition form of puja only? Real devotion means no-otherness but this form of puja maintains otherness)

owis.original: देवाचें तीर्थ कैसें घ्यावें । देवासी गंध कोठें लावावें । मंत्रपुष्प तरी वावें । कोणें ठाईं ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देह नसेल तर देवाचे तीर्थ घेता येणार नाहीं. देवाला गंध लावता येणार नाहीं. देवाला मंत्रपुष्प वाहता येणार नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: How can this water that washed an idol be considered as the *sacred water from that true God's feet? How can one apply sandalwood paste to that God? How can a mantra and a handful of flowers be an offering to that God? *(Knowledge is this sacred water)

owis.original: म्हणोनी देह्याविन आडतें । अवघें सांकडेचि पडतें । देह्याकरितां घडतें । भजन कांहीं ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा रीतीनें सगळीकडे देहावांचून अदतें. देह नसेल तर मोठी अडचण पडतें. देहाच्या सहाय्यानेंच भगवंताचें भजन घडूं शकतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore, without the body one cannot worship God and yet it is due to this body consciousness that there are the `many' forms of worship and then one falls into the pit of confusion. Still understand, by this body there can be the bhajan of the `many' gods and the bhajan of this `thing' also.

owis.original: देव देवता भूतें देवतें । मुळींचें सामर्थ्ये आहे तेथें । अधिकारें नाना देवतें । भजत जावीं ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव, देवता, भुतें आणि दैवतें यांच्या ठिकाणीं मुळांतील सामर्थ्य असतें. ज्याच्यात्याच्या अधिकाराप्रमाणें अनेक प्रकारची दैवतें पूजावी. सर्व देवांचा व दैवतांचा अधिकार सारखा नसतो. हेम ध्यानांत ठेवून त्यांना मानावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this power of the root (ie. knowledge/existence), there is that *God, His goddess, the subtle elements and these gunas and that brahman `there' (brahman is still and formless, and this power is His form). It is due His authority that there are these gunas and the `many' gods that the people make their bhajans to. *(God- mula purush, goddess- mula prakruti. `Here' the elements and the gunas are unmanifest)

owis.original: नाना देवीं भजन केलें । तें मूळ पुरुषासी पावलें । याकारणें सन्मानिलें । पाहिजे सकळ कांहीं ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक प्रकारच्या देवांचे जरी भजन केलें तरी तें अखेर मूळ पुरुषास जाऊन पोचतें. या कारणानें सर्व प्रकारच्या देवांना त्यांच्या त्यांच्यापरी मान द्यावा.
owis.englishMeaning: The people make their bhajan's to their `many' gods within that One God, but still their worships do reach that mula purush (for He is the Knower within each of them). For the same reason too, by means of this `speech', this `all thing' should be given respect and honoured (the worship of mula maya is received by that God/mula purush).

owis.original: मायावल्ली फांपावली । नाना देहेफळीं लगडली । मुळींची जाणीव कळों आली । फळामधें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मायारुपी वेल भरमसाट वाढली. तिला अनेक प्रकारची देहरुपी फळें आली. त्या फळांनी ती अगदी भरुन गेली. मूळ पुरुषाच्या ठिकाणीं जी जाणीव आहे, तीच अखेर देहरुपी फळामधें प्रगट झाली.
owis.englishMeaning: It is that One that has spread as this creeper called mind and it is that One who is mixed within Its `many' fruits (ie. these pains and pleasures). Therefore this knowing that comes from the root should be understood within the `many' fruits (by leaving off the desire for pleasure one will come upon this ever present root or seed of the world).

owis.original: म्हणोनी येळील न करावें । पाहाणें तें येथेंचि पाहावें । ताळा पडतां राहावें । समाधानें ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून कंटाळा करुं नये. टाळाटाळ करुं नये. अंतरात्म्याबद्दल जें कांहीं पहायचे असेल तें येथेंच या देहांतच पहावें. आणि विवेकानें तत्वांचा मेळ बसला कीं समाधान पावून मग स्वस्थ राहावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore one should not become lazy. By understanding this `all' of maya, one will reach brahman. When this relationship between the body and that atma ceases then, one should remain with the complete contentment of that swarup.

owis.original: प्राणी संसार टाकिती । देवास धुंडीत फिरती । नाना अनुमानीं पडती । जेथ तेथें ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसें संसार सोडतात व देवाला धुंडीत फिरतात. आणि जेथें तेथें विनाकारण कल्पनेच्या गुंत्यांत अडकतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If that One confined in the prana, abandons its samsar and wanders around sear- ching for God then, that One falls into the `many' conjectures and confusions. (It is not enough that one abandons the household in search for God. For one has not learned that it is these concepts and this body that have to be abandoned. If one maintains this concept of being a body then the search for God can only lead to confusion)

owis.original: लोकांची पाहातां रीती । लोक देवार्चनें करिती । अथवा क्षत्रदेव पाहाती । ठाईं ठाईं ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लोकांची तर्‍हा अशी आहे कीं, देवाची पूजाअर्चा करावी किंवा अनेक ठिकाणच्या क्षेत्रांमधील देव बघावे, याचा त्यांना हव्यास असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If you see this world with its `many' ways then, there is the making of `many' of- ferings to God. But if you understood that that God is within the body then, at every place, everything is offered to Him (ie. sagun worship).

owis.original: अथवा नाना अवतार । ऐकोनी धरिती निर्धार । परी तें अवघें सविस्त‍हार । होऊन गेलें ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कांहीं लोक अनेक अवतारांच्या कथा ऐकतात. आणि त्यापैकी एका अवतारावर निष्ठा ठेवतात. पण सगळे अवतार आपआपले कार्य संपवून मूळपुरुषाशी गेलेले असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When you understood that these `many' gods are this knowledge then, while liste- ning to this `I am', that One who requires no support can be realized and firmly held (nirgun worship). But if that Reality expands outward, due to the `many' things, then that Reality will surely get lost.

owis.original: येक ब्रह्माविष्णुमहेश । ऐकोन म्हणतीं हे विशेष । गुणातीत जो जगदीश । तो पाहिला पाहिजे ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कांहीं लोकांना ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, महेश यांच्याविषयीम श्रवण करुन आकर्षण उत्पन्न होते. पण क्षेत्रांतील देव काय, किंवा अवतार काय किंवा त्रिमूर्ति काय हे सारे देव त्रिगुणाच्या राज्यांत वावरतात. म्हणून त्रिगुणांच्या पलीकडे असणारा जगदीश्र्वर अथवा परमात्मा पाहणें खरें आवश्यक आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When that One is lost, then there is brahma, vishnu and shankara (the three gunas). And when there is this listening then, that thoughtless swarup gets called this pure sat- twa guna/knowledge. But the Lord of the world, beyond this guna (ie. beyond listening), That should be understood.

owis.original: देवासी नाहीं थानमान । कोठें करावें भजन । हा विचार पाहातां अनुमान । होत जातो ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव सर्व ठिकाणीं असल्यानें त्याचे राहण्याचे एकअसें ठिकाण नाहीं. अशा देवाचें भजन कोठें करावें, असा विचार जर आपण करीत बसलो तर आपण कल्पनांच्या घोटाळ्यांत अडकून बसूं.
owis.englishMeaning: They say, "God has no place or quality, so where and how can His bhajan be made?" But if thoughtlessness is understood, then such conjecture does not arise.

owis.original: नसतां देवाचें दर्शन । कैसेन होईजे पावन । धन्य धन्य ते साधुजन । सकळ जाणती ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रत्यक्ष सगुण व साकार मूर्तीचे दर्शन होणें म्हणजें देवाचे दर्शन होय. अशी आपली भ्रामक समजूत असते. म्हणून आपल्या मनांत येते कीं, देवाचे दर्शन झाले नाहीं तर आपण पावन होणार नाहीं. यासाठी देव व देव दर्शन यांचे रहस्य संपूर्णपणें ज्यांना माहित असते असे साधुपुरुष धन्य असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If you don't have this knowledge of God then, how will He ever be reached? Blessed is that sadhu and the Knower of this `all'.

owis.original: भूमंडळीं देव नाना । त्यांची भीड उलंघेना । मुख्य देव तो कळेना । कांहीं केल्यां ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगांत पुष्कळ देव आढळतात. त्यांची भीड उल्लंघन करुन पलीकडे जाववत नाहीं. म्हणून खरा व मुख्य देव कांहीं केल्या कळत नाहीं. मानवसमाजांत आढळणारे नाना देव अखेर सारे मानवनिर्मित आहेत आणि त्या सर्वांना निर्भयपणें बाजूस सारुन जो देवाचा शोध करतो, त्यासच खरा गुणातीत देव सांपडतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If there are the `many' gods in this world and the fear of these are not thrown off then, this created `thing' and that Supreme God cannot be understood.

owis.original: कर्तुत्व वेगळें करावें । मग त्या देवासी पाहावें । तरीच कांहींयेक पडे ठावें । गौप्यगुह्य ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणूस कर्तेपणाच्या भ्रमांत वावरत असतो. त्यामुळें देवाचे कर्तृत्व आकलन करण्यास लागणारी सूक्ष्म ज्ञानदृष्टी त्याच्या ठिकाणीं नसतें. म्हणून आपण कर्तेपणाहून बाजूस सरावें, म्हणजे मग खर्‍या देवाला पहाता येते. आपण कर्तेपण सोडून पाहूं लागल्यावर देवाचें गुप्त रहस्य थोडेंसे आकलन होऊं लागतें.
owis.englishMeaning: And if this power of doing is not passed over also then, that *God will not be realized. For only when this knowledge is passed over will that most hidden, the One within this `thing', be discovered. *(siddharameshwar maharaj- doing nothing is the greatest worship)

owis.original: तें दिसेना ना भासेना । कल्पांतीं हि नासेना । सुकृतावेगळें विश्र्वासेनाा । तेथें मन ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: खरा देव किंवा शाश्वत परमात्मस्वरुप इंद्रियांना दिसत नाहीं. व मनाला भासत नाहीं. कल्पान्ताच्या वेळीं देखील त्यास नाश नाहीं. चांगलें पुण्यबल नसेल तर त्याच्यावर मनाचा विश्र्वास बसत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Understand, that Reality cannot be seen or perceived and yet even when imagination ceases, still That is not destroyed. That is different from this pure action of knowledge (ie. nothing is there), for the mind cannot keep faith `there'. (This knowledge is a necessary step to understand no knowledge. Therefore the mind must go off; for the mind cannot go beyond imagination or knowledge)

owis.original: उदंड कल्पिते कल्पना । उदंड इच्छिते वासना । अभ्यांतरीं तरंग नाना । उदयातें पावती ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसाच्या मनांत उदंड कल्पना येत राहतात. त्याचप्रमाणें त्याची वासना नाना प्रकारच्या खूप इच्छा करीत राहते. त्याच्या अंतरंगांत अनेक वृत्ति उदय पावतात. मनाची अशी स्थिति जोपर्यंत आहे, तोपर्यंत खर्‍या देवाचे दर्शन होणें शक्य नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore the mind should understand that, it is that vast paramatma that has imagined the imagined; it is that vast paramatma that had wished for the vasana to be and then in the inner heart when the waves of the `many' had arisen, that One appeared as these `many' forms of worship.

owis.original: म्हणोनी कल्पनारहित । तेचि वस्तु शाश्र्वत । अंत नाहीं म्हणोनी अनंत । बोलिजे तया ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून जें कल्पनारहित तत्व आहे तीच शाश्वत वस्तु होय. त्या वस्तुला अंत नाहीं म्हणून तिला अनंत असें म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore beyond imagination/thoughts, there is that eternal Self. He has no end and therefore That should be called endless.

owis.original: हें ज्ञानदृष्टीनें पाहावें । पाहोनी तेथेंचि राहावें । निजध्यासें तद्रूप व्हावें । संगत्यागें ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्ञानदृष्टीनें ती वस्तु पहावी. आणि पाहून तिच्यापाशी राहावें. आपण आधी निःसंग बनावें आणि नंतर निदिध्यासनानें त्या वस्तुशी तद्रुप होऊन जावें.
owis.englishMeaning: That thoughtless Self will be understood by these eyes of knowledge; for while watching with this understanding one will enter and remain `there'. This is *nija-dhyasa and then one should stay as that thoughtless swarup where all company/attachment has been abandoned (ie. satkshatkar).

owis.original: नाना लीळा नाना लाघवें । तें काये जाणिजे बापुड्या जीवें । संतसंगें स्वानुभवें । स्थिति बाणे ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तसे तद्रुप झाल्यावर माणसाच्या हातून ज्या अनेक लीला व विस्मयकारक गोष्टी घडतात, त्याची कल्पना बिचार्‍या सामान्य जीवाला येऊं शकत नाहीं. संतांची संगत व स्वतःचा अनुभव या दोन्ही साधनांनी ही स्थिति अंगी बाणतें.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the `many' plays and the `many' skills by the confused jiva then, how can that Reality be known? Only by satsang (ie. company of the Truth) can one's Self-experience is established.

owis.original: ऐसी सूक्ष्म स्थिति गती । कळतां चुके अधोगती । सद्गुरुचेनि सद्गती । तत्काळ होते ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: खर्‍या देवाच्या दर्शनाची स्थिति व परिणामीं अवस्था अशीं सूक्ष्म आहे. ती कळली तर अधोगती चुकते. सद्गुरुचा लाभ झाला तर त्याच्या कृपेनें उत्तम अवस्था फार लवकर लाभते.
owis.englishMeaning: In this way, there is the attainment of that brahman. And if That is understood then, these degrading conditions are avoided. But without sadguru that True state cannot be attained. .

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: परमार्थी आणि विवेकी । त्याचें करणें माने लोकीं । कां जे विवरविवरों चुकी । पडोंचि नेदी ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो परमार्थी असतो आणि विवेकीही असतो, त्याचे करणे लोकांमध्यें मान्य होते. आपण जें करायचें त्यावर पुनः पुनः विचार करुन तो आपल्या हातून चूक होऊं देत नाहीं. हे त्याचे कारण होय.
owis.englishMeaning: The *paramarthi and the viveki respect this action of the `all' that has been made by that purush within this gross world. But why should this mula maya be allowed to give up continuous investigation? (Even if knowledge is understood still, without going beyond knowledge, that Reality remains a mystery. Therefore this `all' understanding should never ever be left) *(The one who seeks to know the Supreme meaning)

owis.original: जो जो संदेह वाटे जना । तो तो कदापी करीना । आदिअंत अनुमाना । आणून सोडी ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या ज्या कृतीमुळें लोकांच्या मनांत संदेह निर्माण होईल असें कोणतेंहि कर्म तो केव्हांहि करीत नाहीं, प्रत्येक गोष्टीचा आरंभ व अखेरचा परिणाम यांचा बरोबर विचार तो आधींच करुन ठेवतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that purush has body consciousness then, this gross world is felt to be true and He can never know Himself. Therefore all conjecture, from the beginning to the end, should be found and cast away (maharaj- zero plus zero, zero minus zero, zero divided by zero or zero multiplied by zero; whichever way you look at it; it is always zero).

owis.original: स्वता निस्पृह असेना । त्याचें बोलणेंचि मानेना । कठीण आहे जनार्दना । राजी राखणें ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणूस जर स्वतः निःस्पृह नसेल तर त्याचे बोलणें फारसे कोणी मानीत नाहीं. जनीजनार्दनाला म्हणजें लोकांना खूष ठेवणें फार कठीण आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When one is not by nature desireless then, this `speech' of that purush is not valued and then it is very difficult to keep vishnu contented (vishnu/sattwa guna wants just to know).

owis.original: कोणी दाटून उपदेश देती । कोणी मध्यवर्ती घालिती । ते सहजचि हळु पडती । लालचीनें ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गुरुपणाच्या व्यवहारांत कोणी जबरदस्तीनें उपदेश देतात. तर कोणी मध्यस्थी घालून उपदेश देतात. पण लोभीपणामुळें अशा गुरुंचे महत्त्व  आपोआपच कमी होत जातें.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that One will swell with pride and give spiritual instructions; when that One sets himself up as a Master (ie. the One without any pride) then, that natural Reality comes tumbling down into a body, due to Its greed (maharaj- I was a free bird, I did not even want to be a Master I tell you).

owis.original: जयास सांगावा विवेक । तोचि जाणावा प्रतिकुंचक । पुढें पुढें नासक । कारबार होतो ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कांहीं वेळेस असें होतें कीं, ज्याला उपदेश करायचा तो स्वतःच विरुद्ध असतो. असें असेल तर पुढें सर्व कारभार नासून जातो.
owis.englishMeaning: Thoughtlessness should be understood by mula maya, otherwise that purush be- comes known as something else (that purush is the One and only atma but, if this illusion/maya remains then, that Knower who can't be known, becomes known as so- mething else) and then again and again, that One gets spoiled in the affairs of this world.

owis.original: भावास भाऊ उपदेश देती । पुढें पुढें होते फजीती । वोळखीच्या लोकांत महंती । मांडूंचि नये ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कांहीं ठिकाणी भाऊच भावास उपदेश करतो. पण पुढें त्याची फजिती होते. म्हणून ओळखीच्या लोकांमध्यें गुरुपणा मिरवूं नये. आणि त्यांना उपदेश देऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: If a brother gives his brother spiritual instruction then, that brother will ridicule him afterwards. Therefore, that purush within this world of the known (`all'), should not show Himself off (ie. the nature of the world is to find fault and the nature of the individual is to show off the little knowledge that they know. Therefore be that purush and maintain constant detachment).
