owis.original: पहिलें दिसे परी नासे । विवेकी मान्य करिती कैसे । अविवेकी ते जैसे तैसें । मिळती तेथें ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आरंभी गुरुपणाचा तोरा कांहीं दिवस चालतो. पण कांहीं दिवसांनमतर तो नाहींसा होतो. विवेकी माणसांना हा प्रकार पसंत पडत नाहीं. अशा गुरुपाशी अविवेकी माणसेंच कशीतरी जमतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Whatever is seen by the eyes gets destroyed; tell me, how then can a viveki have respect for that which is destructible? In the same way, how can the a-viveki have respect for and meet that Reality `there'? (The a-viveki imagines this destructible world and thinks it is indestructible)

owis.original: भ्रतार शिष्य स्त्री गुरु । हाहि फटकाळ विचारु । नाना भ्रष्टाकारी प्रकारु । तैसाचि आहे ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नवरा शिष्य व बायको गुरु हा सुद्धा एक अव्यवहारीपणाचा, अविवेकीपणाचा प्रकार आहे. भ्रष्टाचाराचे इतर प्रकार  अशाच तर्‍हेचे असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If the husband is the disciple and his wife is the guru, then thoughtlessness has become something quite fruitless (when that true purush has become a devotee of His prakruti then He will surely fall into further delusion. Then there will be man, woman, husband and wife etc.). And then afterwards, within this delusional `all' form, there will be the ways of the `many'.

owis.original: प्रगट विवेक बोलेना । झांकातापा करी जना । मुख्य निश्र्चय अनुमाना । आणूंच नेदी ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असले भ्रष्टाचरी गुरु, खर्‍या परमार्थाचा विचार स्पष्टपणें सांगत नाहीत. लोकांपुढें लपवाछपवी करुन त्यांना नादी लावतात. मुख्य आत्मज्ञानाचा निश्र्चय त्यांच्या कल्पनेंतही येऊं देत नाहींत. अशा रीतीनें तें लोकांना फसवतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If this `speech' of vivek is not understood then, there are the deceitful and hurried actions of the people.7 Therefore the conviction of that Supreme should not be allowed to bring any such conjecture.

owis.original: हुकीसरिसा भरीं भरे । विवेक सांगता न धरे । दुरीदृष्टीचे पुरे । साधु नव्हेती ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असे गुरु मनाच्या लहरीप्रमाणें कशाच्या तरी भरीला पडतात. कोणी विवेकाच्या गोष्टी सांगू लागला तर ते त्या ऐकत नाहीत. हे असले गुरु किंवा महंत दूरदृष्टीचे खरे साधु नव्हेत.
owis.englishMeaning: If the mind is suddenly filled with desire or imagination then, vivek has not been firmly held. Then one is caught in a flood of great misfortune and cannot be that sadhu.

owis.original: कोण्हास कांहींच न मागावें । भगवद्भजन वाढवावें । विवेकबळें जन लावावे । भजनाकडे ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: साधूनें कोणापाशीं कांहीं मागूं नये. त्यानें भगवंताचे भजन वाढवावे. विवेकाच्या जोतावर लोकांना त्यानें भगवंताकडे वळवावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Why should this `thing' beg to anyone (`I am everything, everywhere, always; what need have I of anything more')? Therefore its bhajan* to God should be made to grow and grow (maharaj- become so big that you go off). Therefore by continuous, powerful vivek, this mind should be turned towards bhajan. *(bhajan- `I am the root of all this; but who I am, I don't know')

owis.original: परांतर रक्षयाचीं कामें । बहुत कठीण विवेकवर्में । स्वइच्छेनें स्वधर्में । लोकराहाटी ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लोकांचे अंतःकरण कसें राखावें, या कामांतील विवेकाचे वर्म आकलन होण्यास फार कठीण आहे. कारण बहुजनसमाज आपापल्या इच्छेप्रमाणें व स्वभावाप्रमाणें वागत असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If that purush beyond this inner space has any need of maya then, that essence of vivek has become this `all' of maya. And then afterwards our own `wish' (`I want to be') and our own true dharma/swadharma (I do not exist) become the ways of this gross world.

owis.original: आपण तुरुक गुरु केला । शिष्य चांभार मेळविला । नीच यातीनें नासला । समुदाव ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समजा, एखाद्या माणसानें मुसलमान गुरु केला. एक चांभार शिष्य म्हणून मिळवला अशा या प्रकारानें लोकसमुह नासतो, विघटीत होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then the ego makes itself the guru and he takes his disciple to be a body. By dividing that which is ever constant, this meeting-place of the `all' gets spoiled (because of ignorance and `many' desires and concepts etc., this `all' is as if destroyed).

owis.original: ब्राह्मणमंडळ्या मेळवाव्या । भक्तमंडळ्या मानाव्या । संतमंडळ्या शोधाव्या । भूमंडळीं ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्राह्मणमंडळ्या मिळवाव्या, भक्तमंडळ्यांना मान द्यावा. आणि जगांत संतमंडळ्यांचा शोध घ्यावा.
owis.englishMeaning: One should meet in that place of the brahmin. One should honour that place of the devotee. One should search out that place of the Saint who is within this world (when a disciple asked Christ, "When will I get to heaven," Christ said, "Heaven is here, but you don't understand").

owis.original: उत्कट भव्य तेंचि घ्यावें । मळमळीत अवघेंचि टाकावें । निस्पृहपणें विख्यात व्हावें । भूमंडळीं ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समाजनेत्यानें जें उत्कट आणि भव्य असेल तें घ्यावें. जे तेजोहीन, गतिहीन व बलहीन असेल त्याचा त्याग करावा. आपल्या निःस्पृहपणानें जगांत प्रसिद्ध व्हावें.
owis.englishMeaning: That Reality has become this very powerful `all' and its nature is existence. There- fore first accept that you are this `all'. Then the dull, spiritless, disorderly and `many' thoughts will be thrown out and through desirelessness one will pervade the whole world.

owis.original: अक्षर बरें वाचणें बरें । अर्थांतर सांगणें बरें । गाणें नाचणें अवघेंचि बरें । पाठांतर ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याचे अक्षर सुंदर असतें. वाचणें चांगलें असते. वाचलेल्या भागाचा तो चांगला अर्थ सांगतो. त्याचे पाठांतर उत्तम असते. त्याचेगाणें, नाचणें सुंदर असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to wisdom there is that indestructible thoughtless Self and due to wisdom there is this witnessing also. But thoughtlessness is the innermost meaning and it should be understood through this wisdom (ie. witnessing). When you `sing' and `dance' (`I am everything everywhere,' this `all' is my `song' and my `dance') then, the mind becomes your wise inner support (the mind becomes your best friend).

owis.original: दीक्षा बरी मीत्री बरी । तीक्ष्ण बुधी राजकारणी बरी । आपणास राखे नाना परी । अलिप्तपणें ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याची दिक्षा छान असते, त्याची मैत्री सुरेख असते. राजकारणांत त्याची तीक्ष्न बुद्धि चांगली चालते. सर्व क्षेत्रांत वावरणारा हा पुरुष अलिप्तपणें वागून स्वतःस सांभाळतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then your conduct is wise and your friendship is wise. Then your buddhi is keen and sharp and it understands that He is the doer of everything. Then your buddhi remains aloft from the ways of the `many' and it protects you (maharaj- then the mind is your best friend and it will never turn).

owis.original: अखंड हरिकथेचा छंदु । सकळांस लागे नामवेदु । प्रगट जयाचा प्रबोधु । सूर्य जैसा ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याला अखंड हरिकथेचा छंद असतो. तो लोकांना नामस्मरणास लावतो. त्याचे ज्ञान सूर्यासारखें तेजस्वी व उघड असते.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is an unbroken fondness for this `story' of God then, this `all' is always engaged in taking His name and this awakened buddhi of mula maya will shine like the sun.

owis.original: दुर्जनासी राखों जाणे । सज्जनासी निवऊं जाणे । सकळांचे मनीचें जाणे । ज्याचें त्यापरीं ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दुर्जनाला कसें सांभाळावें हें तो जाणतो. तसेच सज्जनाच्या मनाला शांति कशी द्यावी हें त्याला माहित असते. ज्याच्या त्याच्यापरीनें प्रत्येक माणसाच्या अंतरांत काय आहे हें तो जाणतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then one knows how to keep the mind which is far from the atma in order and then one knows the calm and rest of the Saint. Then one knows that the mind is this `all' and you, are that purush.

owis.original: संगतीचें मनुष्य पालटे । उत्तम गुण तत्काळ उठे । अखंड अभ्यासीं लगटे । समुदाव ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याच्या संगतींत राहिलेला माणूस आंतून बदलतो. त्या माणसाच्या ठिकाणीं उत्तम गुण प्रगट होतात. त्या महंताच्याजवळ असलेला शिष्य परिवार मनापासून परमार्थाच्या अभ्यासाला लागतो.
owis.englishMeaning: A man gets changed due to His company and then that best guna arises. Then this `all' is continuously absorbed in this practice.

owis.original: जेथें तेथें नित्य नवा । जनासी वाटे हा असावा । परंतु लालचीचा गोवा । पडोंचि नेदी ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो जेथे जातो तेथें नवाच वाटतो. तो असावा असे लोकांना वाटते. पण कोणाकडून कांहीं मिळावे अशा लोभाच्या जाळ्यांत तो चुकून सुद्धां अडकत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When everywhere is indestructible and ever new then, thoughtlessness should come to the mind. But That should never be allowed to fall into the entanglement of greed ("I know this and I want that").

owis.original: उत्कट भक्ति उत्कट ज्ञान । उत्कट च्यातुर्य उत्कट भजन । उत्कट योग अनुष्ठान । ठाईं ठाईं ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याची भक्ति, ज्ञान, चातुर्य, भजन आणि योग हे सर्व उत्कट असतात. ठिकठिकाणचे त्याचे अनुष्ठानही उत्कट असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is powerful devotion and powerful knowledge; when there is powerful wisdom and powerful bhajan; then there is union with that original place.

owis.original: उत्कट निस्पृहता धरिली । त्याची कीर्ति दिगांतीं फांकली । उत्कट भक्तीनें निवाली । जनमंडळी ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याच्या अंगी उत्कट निस्पृहता असते. त्यामुळें त्याची कीर्ति दिगंत पसरते. त्याच्या उत्कट भक्तीनें लोकांच्या मनाला शांति मिळते.
owis.englishMeaning: When one maintains powerful detachment, then your pervasiveness spreads beyond the boundaries of the universe. By powerful devotion one becomes calm and pure even when in the company of the people (maharaj- when you understand yourself completely then, let any thoughts come, for you know I am not the thoughts).

owis.original: कांही येक उत्कटेविण । कीर्ति कदापि नव्हे जाण । उगेंच वणवण हिंडोन । काये होतें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या जीवनांत कशामध्यें तरी उत्कटता असल्याखेरीज कीर्ति मिळणार नाहीं. उगाच वणवण हिंडून कांहीं साधणार नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: If the One within this `thing' does not know His power then, there can never be this pervasiveness. If that still and silent Self wanders aimlessly in this world then, what will It achieve?

owis.original: नाहीं देह्याचा भरंवसा । केव्हां सरेल वयसा । प्रसंग पडेल कैसा । कोण जाणे ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहाचा भरंवसा नसतो. आयुष्य केव्हां संपेल हें कांहीं सांगता येत नाहीं. पुढें कोणता प्रसंग येईल हें कोणी सांगू शकत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: This body cannot even be trusted to tell you when it is going to leave (maharaj- it is so faithless; it doesn't even say good-bye). Then who knows when this `I am' connection will end? (This body is a dead body at the moment; it is this `I am' feeling that is within every creature that is giving this body life/existence. But taking yourself to be a body, this `I am' is at the mercy of karma and death)

owis.original: याकारणें सावधान असावें । जितुकें होईल तितुकें करावें । भगवत्कीर्तिनें भरावें । भूमंडळ ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून मोठे सावधपणानें असावें. आज जेवढें लोकांसाठीं करतां येईल तेवढें करावें. भगवंताच्या कीर्तिनें सारे जग भरुन टाकावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore there should be the alertness of this `speech'. Whatever will be, that only one should do (ie. let whatever has to come, come; why should I want it any other way?). And one should fill this world with the pervasiveness of God.

owis.original: आपणास जें जें अनकूळ । तें तें करावें तात्काळ । होईना त्यास निवळ । विवेक उमजावा ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आज आपल्याला जें जें करणें अनुकुल असेल तें तें तत्काळ करुन टाकावें. जें आपल्याकडून होण्यासारखें नाहीं त्यावर नीट विवेक करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: Whatever mula maya brings to you, this only should be done at that time (to be in the `now' or `all' and not to `stick your dirty nose' into anything; the mind will ask, "If I become He then what should I do? But have faith that whatever is in this moment is correct, why should I worry). Yet pure vivek should understand that, this also did not happen (knowledge takes itself as true, something is happening; but one should understand that even this, being in the now/`I am' is not the Truth. To that Reality, nothing has ever happened).

owis.original: विवेकामधें सांपडेना । ऐसें तो कांहींच असेना । येकांतीं विवेक अनुमाना । आणून सोडी ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विेवेकाच्या मर्यादेंत येत नाहीं अशी गोष्टच जगांत नाहीं. म्हणून एकांतांत विवेक करावा. म्हणजें आपल्या हातून जें होत नाहीं, तें अनुमानाच्या दृष्टीनें येते व समजते.
owis.englishMeaning: Just as conjecture cannot be found in vivek, so too this `thing' even, cannot be found in that atma. In `aloneness' vivek brings all this conjecture and then tosses it away.

owis.original: अखंड तजवीजा चाळणा जेथें । पाहातां काय उणें तेथें । येकांतेंविण प्राणीयांतें । बुद्धि कैसी ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो माणुस सतत विचार करुन उपाययोजना करतो त्याच्यापाशीं कांहीहि उणे पडत नाहीं. एकांत सेवन केल्याखेरीज माणसाला खोल बुद्धि प्राप्त होत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When one thoughtfully and continuously searches `here' then, what will be lacking `there? But how can there be such a buddhi, without this `aloneness'?

owis.original: येकांतीं विवेक करावा । आत्माराम वोळखावा । येथून तेथवरी गोवा । कांहींच नाहीं ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून महंतानें एकांतांत जाऊन विवेक करावा. आत्मारामाचा साक्षात्कार करुन घ्यावा. म्हणजे मग कोणत्याहि गोष्टींत कांहींच घोटाळा उरत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: In `aloneness' there should be vivek and that atmaram should be recognized. Then from `here' to `there', there is not even the confusion of this `thing'. .

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: कथेचें घमंड भरुन द्यावें । आणी निरुपणीं विवरावें । उणें पडोंचि नेदावें । कोणीयेकचविषीं ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भगवंताच्या कथेनें सारे वातावरण भरुन टाकावें. निरुपणामधें अध्यात्माचे विवरण करावें. यापैकीं कशांतही उणीव पडूं देऊ नये.
owis.englishMeaning: The sweet sound of this story `I am' should fill this whole world and then, within this `all', thoughtlessness should be understood. That One who is within everyone should not be allowed to feel that there is something lacking or missing (whatever is here is in knowledge and even this knowledge has appeared upon my thoughtless Self). (maharaj one should be perfect in one's thinking).

owis.original: भेजणार खालें पडिला । तो भेजणारीं जाणितला । नेणता लोक उगाच राहिला । टकमकां पाहात ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा कसरतीचे खेळ करणारा पडला तर काय चूक झाली म्हणून तो पडला हें असें कसरतीचें खेळ करणार्‍या माणसाच्याच लक्षांत येते. इतर अज्ञानी लोक मात्र इकडे तिकडे टकाटका बघत बसतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If that One making bhajan forgets Himself then, that bhajani comes down into knowledge. And if that still and silent Self does not know this knowledge then, He just stares ahead with hopes and dreams.

owis.original: उत्तर विलंबीं पडिलें । श्रोतयांस कळों आलें । म्हणिजे महत्व उडालें । वक्तयाचें ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याचप्रमाणें श्रोत्यानीं वक्त्याला प्रश्र्ण विचारला, आणि वक्त्याला उत्तर देण्यास वेळ लागला, तर त्याला उत्तर सुचत नाहीं ही गोष्ट श्रोत्याच्या धा्यानांत येते. मग श्रोते वक्त्याची किंमत ओळखतात. आणि मग वक्त्याचे महत्व उडून जाते.
owis.englishMeaning: If there is some hesitation in this `reply' (`I am He') then, the listener will come to know. And due to this hesitation, the greatness of the speaker will fly away (the listener and the speaker is within only. For in truth, there is no-one in this world but yourself. Therefore the listener who hears this `word' is you and the speaker who speaks this `word' is also you. And it is you who knows if you have stopped listening and at that time, it is you who falls down into the many thoughts and who shows disrespect to the speaker within)

owis.original: थोडें बोलोनि समाधान करणें । रागेजोन तरी मन धरणें । मनुष्य वेधींच लावणें । कोणीयेक ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: महंतानें थोडे बोलून समाधान करावें. राग आला तरी तो दाबून टाकावा, पण श्रोत्यामचें मन दुखवूं नये. प्रत्येकाला आपल्याकडे आकर्षित करुन घ्यावे.
owis.englishMeaning: A few were making this `speech' and this action brought complete contentment. But then some emotion arose and was held fast to by the mind. See how it is the man himself who creates this obstruction between himself and that One who is within everyone! (ie. the speaker)

owis.original: सोसवेना चिणचिण केली । तेथें तामसवृत्ती दिसोन आली । आवघी आवडी उडाली । श्रोतयाची ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रोत्यांचें वागणेम सहन न होऊन महंतानें जर चिडचिड केली तर त्याची तामसी वृत्ती दिसून येते. मगत्याच्यावर असलेले श्रोत्यांचे प्रेम उडून जातें.
owis.englishMeaning: If this restless wanting is not endured (let whatever will come, come) then, in that brahman, ignorant desires arise and then that brahman sees through the senses and in these `many' thoughts, the fondness for listening to this `I am' flies away.

owis.original: कोण कोण राजी राखिले । कोण कोण मनी भंगिले । क्षणक्षणा परीक्षिले । पाहिजे लोक ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्यावर कोण प्रसन्न आहेत. आपण कोणाचा मनोभंग केला आहे. आपण कोणाचे मन दुखावलें आहे. हें वारंवार लोकांची परीक्षा घेऊन बघावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Some willingly keep this `all' and some break this `all' with their minds. Therefore each and every moment one should examine this world (and this `all' world ie. heaven, should be perceived).

owis.original: शिष्य विकल्पें रान घेतो । गुरु मागें मागें धंवतो । विचार पाहों जातां तो । विकल्पचि अवघा ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा शिष्य भलताच शंका काढणारा आहे. तसें करतांना तो विकल्पाच्या फसतो व गुरुही त्याच्यामागें समजूत काढण्यासाठीं त्याच्या मागें धावतो. तर ते दोघेही संदेहाच्या चक्रांत अडकलें आहेत असें समजावें.
owis.englishMeaning: But if the shishya accepts these vikalp/doubts then, he is confused and lost; still time and time again the guru comes running to show him the way (if there is faith in the guru then, you have faith in your Self and such longing will bring you back to His teachings). However if he truly tries to understand that thoughtless Self then, these `many' doubts will become That.

owis.original: आशाबद्धी क्रियाहीन । नाहीं च्यातुर्याचें लक्षण । ते महंतीची भणभण । बंद नाहीं ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो महंत आशाळभूत आहे, आचारभ्रष्ट आहे व चातुर्यनहीन आहे, अशा महंताची महंती उगीच कटकटी निर्माण करते. तिला कांहीं घरबंद उरत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: These bindings of hopes and inferior actions ("I am doing everything and I will receive the fruits of my actions later") are not the attention of the wise. And the desolate dreariness of samsar has not stopped for that purush.

owis.original: ऐसे गोसावी हळु पडती । ठाईं ठाईं कष्टी होती । तेथें संगतीचे लोक पावती । सुख कैचें ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असले महंत नालायक ठरतात. ठिकठिकाणीं त्यांना दुःखी  होण्याचे प्रसंग येतात त्यांच्या संगतींत राहणार्‍या लोकांना सुखसमाधान मिळणें अशक्य होते.
owis.englishMeaning: Then slowly that renunciate slides downwards into body consciousness and this place of the `all' becomes full of tiresome difficulties. How can the happiness of `there' be attained in this world of attachment?

owis.original: जिकडे तिकडे कीर्ति माजे । सगट लोकांस हव्या उपजे । लोक राजी राखोन कीजे । सकळ कांहीं ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: महंतानें असें वागावें कीं, चहूंकडे त्याची कीर्ति पसरावी. सगळ्या लोकांना त्यांच्याविषयीं आवड उत्पन्न व्हावी. लोकांना संतुष्ट राखून त्यानें सगळें कांहीं करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: `Everywhere is within my pervasiveness'. Such a longing for this world beyond should be born. Therefore in the mind that has created all these things, there should arise a longing to protect this `all thing' only.

owis.original: परलोकीं वास करावा । समुदाव उगाच पाहावा । मागण्याचा तगादा न लवावा । कांहीं येक ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण आत्मानुसंधानाच्या उच्च पातळीवर मनानें राहावें. त्याभूमिकेवरुन लोकसमुदायाचे निरीक्षण करवें. कोणाकडेहीं कांहींही मागण्याचा तगादा लावूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should live in this world beyond and then this meeting place of the `all' should understand that still and silent swarup. Therefore that One within this `thing' should not go begging for reward (maharaj- hopes are dupes).

owis.original: जिकडे जग तिकडे जगन्नायेक । कळला पाहिजे विवेक । रात्रीदिवस विवेकी लोक । सांभाळीत जाती ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या बाजूला बहुजन समाज असतो त्याच बाजूला जगाचा स्वामी जगन्नाथ असतो. हा विचार नीट कळला पाहिजे. विवेकीं महंत हा विचार रात्रंदिवसडोळ्यांपुढें ठेवून वागतात.
owis.englishMeaning: `Where there is a world then, there is the Master of that world.' This should be your vivek. But first, day and night, the mind of the viveki should cherish this world beyond.

owis.original: जो जो लोक दृष्टीस पडिला । तो तो नष्ट ऐसा कळला । अवघेच नष्ट येकला भला । काशावरुनी ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो माणूस दृष्टीस पडतो तो वाईट, बेकार आहे असें समजणे बरोबर नाहीं. जगामधील सर्व माणसें वाईट व आपण तेवढें चांगलें हें कशावरुन खरें मानायचे?
owis.englishMeaning: When that purush descends into this `all' world then, He has lost His understan- ding. And then, when that One gets destroyed by the `many' things, how can there be wisdom?

owis.original: वोस मुलकीं काये पाहावें । लोकांवेगळें कोठें राहावें । तर्‍हे खोटी सांडतें घ्यावें । कांहीं येक ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याप्रमाणें ओसाड प्रातांत पाहाण्यासारखें कांहीं नसते त्याप्रमाणें जनतेला सोडून महंताला राहाता येणार नाहीं.महंतानें तर्‍हेवाईकपणा करणें वाईट असतें. प्रसंगीं त्यानें पडतें घ्यावें पण लोकांना राजी राखावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Why does one need to understand that which is naturally existing? Therefore, other than in this world beyond where should one stay? That One who is within this `thing' is always there and He should let slip these false things (maharaj- how can you be that which is ever changing).

owis.original: तस्मात लोकिकीं वर्ततां नये । त्यास महंती कामा नये । परत्र साधनाचा उपाये । श्रवण करुन असावें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सांगण्याचे कारण असें कीं, महंताला जनतेशी वागता येत नसेल तर त्यानें लोकसंग्रह करुं नये. परमार्थसाधनामधें श्रवण मनन करीत आपला काळ घालवावा.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not come and stay in this worldly life. Therefore that purush should have no desire. The sadhana that is beyond these three worlds is listening/shravan and this should be made.

owis.original: आपणासी बरें पोहतां नये । लोक बुडवावयाचें कोण कार्य । गोडी आवडी वायां जाये । विकल्पचि अवघा ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या माणसाला नीट पोहता येत नाहींत्यानें लोकांना बुडवू नये. अशा अपात्र महंताच्या नादी लागल्यानें माणसाची परमार्थाची आवड व गोडी वाया जाते व गैरसमज पसरतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If you have not learnt how to swim well then, how can you save this world of the drowning (this `all' will be drowned in a mind full of `many' things)? Then due to your spoiled and useless likings, there will be the desires for `many' things.

owis.original: अभ्यासें प्रगट व्हावें । नाहीं तरी झांकोन असावें । प्रगट होऊन नासावें । हें बरें नव्हे ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: साधनाचा उत्तम अभ्यास करुन मग जनतेंत महंतपण प्रगट करावें. नाहींतर साधकानें जनतेपासून स्वतःस झाकून दूर राहावें. जनतेंमधें प्रगट झाल्यावर साधनांतून खाली घसरणें चांगलें नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore one should have no desire and then this `all' world will not remain hidden. But if this `all' becomes apparent and then gets destroyed, that thoughtless wisdom will never arise (ie. if firm conviction is not maintained, thoughts will steal your under- standing away. Therefore a change of mind must come. I am not a body).

owis.original: मंद हळु हळु चालतो । चपळ कैसा अटोपतो । अरबी फिरवणार तो । कैसा असावा ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या माणसाला हळु घोडें चालवण्याची सवय आहे त्याला चपळ घोडा चालविता येत नाहीं. अरबी घोडा मोठा चपळ व हुशार असतो. त्यावर स्वार होणारा माणूससुद्धां तसाच चपळ व हुशार लागतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If you are dull and slow then, how will that smart and active gather up all these `many' thoughts (the antar-atma is the smartest and most active)? If you want to ride a noble Arabian horse then, you must be vigilant and prepared.

owis.original: हे धकाधकीचीं कामें । तिक्षण बुद्धीचीं वर्में । भोळ्या भावार्थें संभ्रमें । कैसें घडे ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हीं सगळीं धक्काबुक्कीची कामें आहेत. ती करण्यासाठीं मोठी तीक्ष्ण बुद्धी लागते. मगवर्म ओळखून ती करावीं लागतात. नुसती श्रद्धा ठेवून ती सुखासुखी करतां येत नाहींत.
owis.englishMeaning: If this sharpness and keenness that is the essence of the buddhi makes only tiresome pushing and shoving then, there is only haste and confusion and the forgetfulness of blind faith.

owis.original: सेत केलें परी वाहेना । जवार केलें परी फिरेना । जन मेळविलें परी धरेना । अंतर्यामीं ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जसें शेतांत पीक घेतलें पण तें विकाला बाजारांत नेलें नाही. जवाहीर विकण्याचा व्यापार आहे, पण ते विकण्यासाठीं हिंडलें नाहीं तर नुकसान होते. तसेंच महंतानें चार लोक गोळा केले पण त्यांचे अंतःरंग सांभाळले नाहीं तर त्याची महंती वाया जाते व फजिती होते.
owis.englishMeaning: One may sow good seeds on the field but not water them. One may be a jeweller but just store away one's jewels. You will be no better than them, if you meet with the people but do not hold this essence of your buddhi within (maharaj- be with the people but do not be like the people).

owis.original: जरी चढती वाढती आवडी उठे । तरी परमार्थ प्रगटे । घसघस करितां विटे । सगट लोकु ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जनतेमध्यें आपल्याबद्दल असणारे प्रेम वाढत गेले तरच परमार्थ प्रगट होतो. अशा महंताच्या प्रयत्नांना यश येते व लोक परमार्थ आचरु लागतात. पण जर आपण व जनता यांच्यामधें संघर्ष निर्माण केला, तर लोक अशा महंताला विटतात. तो त्यांना नकोसा होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If a fondness for such thinking is awakened and that wise thinking rises higher and higher and spreads out further and further then, the Supreme meaning (ie. paramarth) will be understood. But, if there is only haggling and discontentment then, there is only a tarnished lumped together world.

owis.original: आपलें लोकांस मानेना । लोकांचें आपणांस मानेना । आवघा विकल्पचि मना । समाधान कैचें ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या महंताचे लोकांना पटत नाहीं, पसंत पडत नाहीं आणि लोकांचें महंताला पटत नाहीं, पसंत पडत नाहीं, अशा ठिकाणीं दोघांच्या मनांत संशय व गैरसमज असतात. समाधान कोठेंच नसतें.
owis.englishMeaning: If you have no respect for your own world (ie. `I am') then, this world will have no respect for you. If your mind is full of doubts then, how can it gain complete contentment?

owis.original: नासक दीक्षा सिंतरु लोक । तेथें कैचा असेल विवेक । जेथें बळावला अविवेक । तेथें राहणें खोटें ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या ठिकाणीं गुरुचा आचारविचार व साधना बिघडलेली असते, त्याचप्रमाणें त्याच्याभोवती जमलेले अनुयायी लबाड, फसवे असतात. तेथें विवेक आढळणें शक्य नसतें. असा अविवेक जेथें असतो तेथें राहाणें चुकीचे असते.
owis.englishMeaning: If this pure conduct (`He does everything') is spoiled and the mind is entangled then, how can there be the vivek of `there'? If `here' a-vivek grows stronger, then `there' is full of illusion.

owis.original: बहुत दिवस श्रम केला । सेवटीं अवघाचि वेर्थ गेला । आपणास ठाकेना गल्बला । कोणें करावा ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्या महंतानें पुष्कळ दिवस कष्ट सोसले आणि चांगलें अनुयायी मिळविलें, तरी त्या समुहांतील सर्वांना संतुष्ट राखणें, त्यांचे अंतःकरण राखणे शक्य नसतें. हे जर नाहीं केले तर समुह विस्कटतो आणि सर्व श्रम वाया जातात. जनतेची उपाधी व गडबड जर आपल्याला झेपत नसेल तर त्याची जबाबदारी सुरवातीपासूनच आपण घेऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: Then this `all' makes wearisome toil and yet in the end when you die, everything becomes nothing. Therefore you should not be decked out in the confusion of the `many' things and be established in this `all'.

owis.original: संगित चालिला तरी तो व्याप । नाहीं तरी अवघाचि संताप । क्षणक्षणा विक्षेप । किती म्हणौनि सांगावा ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लोकसंग्रहाचे रहस्य हें असें आहे कीं, समूह सरळीत चालला तर तो व्यापक होतो. व त्याचा मनाला त्रास होत नाहीं. पण जर समुह बिघडला तर संघर्ष निर्माण होतो व मनाचा संताप होतो. समुह जीवनांत पदोपदी पुष्कळ अडचणी व गैरसमज निर्माण होतात. त्या सर्वांचे वर्णन करणें शक्य नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: If you sing His song and dance His dance (`I am everything everywhere' or chaitanya is this dance of knowledge) then, that atma pervades. If not, then everything is angu- ish and distress. Then that moment of the One is only confusion, anger and trouble. Therefore the `many' thoughts should understand thoughtlessness.

owis.original: मूर्ख मूर्खपणें भरंगळती । ज्ञाते ज्ञातेपणें कळ्हो करिती । होते दोहीकडे फजीती । लोकांमधें ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समूहांतील मूर्खमाणसें मूर्खपणानें भलतेंच वागतात. तर शहाणी माणसें शहाणपणाच्या अभिमानानें आपसांत भांडतात. मग महंत दोन्ही बाजूंनी कात्रींत सापडतो. मग त्याची फजिती होते.
owis.englishMeaning: The foolish get lost due to their foolishness and knowledgeable quarrel due to their knowledge. Then to both there comes the disgrace of this world.

owis.original: कारबार आटोपेना करवेना । आणि उगेंचि राहेना । याकारणें सकळ जना । काये म्हणावें ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कारभार झेपत नाहीं, आवरत नाहीं, व करवत नाहीं. असे असून स्वस्थही बसवत नाहीं. अशा माणसांना म्हणायचे तरी काय?
owis.englishMeaning: If these worldly affairs, that should not even be done, are not properly managed then, they will sweep us away and then that still and silent cannot remain. Tell me, what should this `speech' say to the people? (Don't care for the talk and affairs of the world and remain in your Self)

owis.original: नासक उपाधीस सोडावें । वय सार्थकीं घालावें । परिभ्रमणें कंठावें । कोठे तरी ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नाश पावणारी उपाधी बाजूस सारावी. परमार्थ साधनाकरुन आपलें वय सार्थकीं लावावे. आणि देशामधें भ्रमण करीत आपलें जीवन कोठेंतरी घालवावें.
owis.englishMeaning: The spoiled limited concept, "I am body", should be left and your life should be used to seek out its meaning (to know my Self). And then as you wander freely through this `all', everything everywhere should be endured (maharaj The world is my Self).

owis.original: परिभ्रमण करीना । दुसर्‍याचें कांहींच सोसीना । तरी मग उदंड यातना । विकल्पाची ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो महंत परिभ्रमण करीत नाहीं, दुसर्‍यासाठीं कांहीं झीज सोसत नाही, त्याला संशयाच्या, देहबुद्धीच्या फार यातना सोसाव्या लागतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If one does not wander freely (ie. does not forget everything) then, this `all thing' cannot be maintained. And then afterwards, that vast paramatma gets the troubles and vexations of body consciousness.

owis.original: आतां हें आपणाचिपासीं । बरें विचारावें आपणासी । अनकूळ पडेल तैसी । वर्तणूल करावी ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतां हें सगळें आपल्यावरच अवलंबून आहे, आपणच आपल्याशी याचा विचार करावा. आणि जे योग्य व अनुकूल वाटेल त्याप्रमाणें वर्तन करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Now, when you understand this `all' then, thoughtlessness is near you and if you keep this `all' in your care then, thoughtlessness will come to you. Therefore let whatever has to come, come and with this understanding meet the world but don't care for anything. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Upadhi Lakshan Nirupan (A Discourse on the Attributes of the Limiting Adjunct)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: सृष्टिमधें बहु लोक । परिभ्रमणें कळे कौतुक । नाना प्रकारीचे विवेक । आडळों लागती ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगांमधें कितीतरी चांगलें लोक आहेत. आपण देशोंदेशी प्रवास केला म्हणजे त्यांचे कौतुक पहावयास मिळतें. अशा प्रवास करण्यानें निरनिराळ्या प्रकारचे विचारसुद्ध आपल्याला समजतात.
owis.englishMeaning: In this gross world there are `many' worlds (maharaj- every mind is a world). But if you wander freely everywhere then, this wonder of the `all' will be understood (ie. forgetting everything and leaving this world you have created by your thoughts and concepts). When there is this vivek then the ways of the `many' can meet with this wonder of the `all' (ie. the two forms of limiting concepts).

owis.original: किती प्रपंची जन । अखंड वृत्ति उदासीन । सुखदुःखें समाधान । दंडळेना ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रपंचांत राहणारी कांहीं माणसें अशी आढळतात कीं त्यांची वृत्ति निरंतर उदासीन म्हणजे अलिप्त आसतें. सुखानें किंवा दुःखानें त्यांचे स्थान डळमळीत होत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Either there are the `many' people of prapanch or there is this vritti of detachment (`I know nothing') or there is that unbroken swarup (beyond any limiting concept). When you understand Yourself then, the pleasures and pains of the world do not disturb your contentment.

owis.original: स्वभावेंचि नेमक बोलती । सहजचि नेमक चालती । अपूर्व बोलण्याची स्थिती । सकळांसी माने ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्यांचा स्वभाव संयमी असतो. जेवढें जरुर तेवधेंच ती बोलतात. आणि नेहमी संयमानेंच वागतात. त्यांची बोलण्याची पद्धत अशी असतें कीं, त्यांचे बोलणें सर्वांना पटते.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that One `speaks' naturally as He was meant to `speak'; then that One `moves' naturally as He was meant to `move'. Then that atma uses this `speech' and gives His respect to this `all'.

owis.original: सहजचि ताळज्ञान येतें । स्वभावेंचि रागज्ञान उमटतें । सहजचि कळत जातें । न्यायेनीतिलक्षण ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा माणूस असा आढळला कीं त्याच्या अंगी तालाचे ज्ञान अगदी सहजच आढळते. एखाद्याच्या अंगी रागांचे ज्ञान आपोआप प्रगट होते. तर एखाद्या माणसाला नीति व न्याय यांची लक्षणें कोणीं न सांगता सहज ध्यानांत येतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Then knowledge of this harmonious `all' connection `here' naturally comes. Then the *knowledge of anger, joy, sorrow etc. naturally appears. Then justice and integrity are naturally understood. *(Now the mind and body function quite naturally without any interference from the ego; for now you know your Self and don't take the touch of this world. maharaj- you don't know how to be angry, you are always calculating how angry should I be. You should be pure anger)

owis.original: येखादा आडळे गाजी । सकळ लोक अखंड राजी । सदा सर्वदा आवडी ताजी । प्राणीमात्राची ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा असा पराक्रमी माणूस आढळतो कीं, त्याच्यावर सगळें लोक नेहमी खूष आसतात. त्याच्यावर असणारें जनतेचे प्रेम सदा ताजे असते.
owis.englishMeaning: If one should meet that brave purush then, this `all' world will appear within that unbroken King (ie. then you will yourself become that atma purush/King and with this knowledge, you will stay in the world). Then that one who had a fondness for being in the prana only, will be ever fresh and always new (and you will become the Lord of the prana).

owis.original: चुकोन उदंड आडळतें । भारी मनुष्य दृष्टीस पडतें । महंताचें लक्षणसें वाटतें । अकस्मात ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादेंवेळी चुकुन मोठें भांडार आढळतें. अशी भव्य व्यक्ति दृष्टीस पडते कीं तिला पाहिल्यावर महंताची सारी लक्षणें तिच्या ठिकाणीं स्पष्ट दिसतात.
owis.englishMeaning: But when that vast paramatma forgets Itself and to this `all' there comes the heavy and gross then suddenly, a man appears before that purush ("I am a man and I see through these eyes and function through this body". But look carefully and recognize that purush who is knowing this thought).

owis.original: ऐसा आडळतां लोक । चमत्कारें गुणग्राहिक । क्रिया बोलणें नेमक । प्रत्ययाचें ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा पुरुषाच्या ठिकाणी आश्र्चर्यकारक गुणग्राहकता दिसून येते. उत्तम गुण आत्मसात करण्याची त्याची शक्ति पाहून चमत्कार वाटतो. त्यांचे बोलणें व वागणें अति नेमके आणि अनुभवाचे असते.
owis.englishMeaning: Either you meet this gross world and become a man or you seize this pure sattwa guna and understand `I am all'. Still understand, this `speech' is the action of that nirgun but, it is not that nirgun. (So, the disciple's mind is to-ing and fro-ing between the limiting concepts of `I am' and "I am a body"; and this `I am' feeling is believed to be that nirgun Reality)

owis.original: सकळ अवगुणामधें अवगुण । आपलें अवगुण वाटती गुण । मोठें पाप करंटपण । चुकेना कीं ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या अवगुणांना गुण मानणें हा माणसाच्या अंगी असणार्‍या अवगुणांमधील सर्वांत मोठा अवगुण आहे. तें मोठे पाप आहे. त्यामुळें माणसाला करंटेपण चुकत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: For this `all' is also like an impure guna within these mixed impure gunas that bring objectification and body consciousness (even this pure sattwa guna or sagun has to be considered impure alongside nirgun). And when that One feels that His qualities created from these impure gunas are good then, that great brahman cannot avoid the sin of taking itself to be a poor miserable body (how can you who are, in truth, that brahman consider that your good qualities are praiseworthy when they have been created from the three gunas and you have tumbled down into body consciousness?).

owis.original: ढाळेंचि काम होतें सदा । जें जपल्यानें नव्हे सर्वदा । तेथें पीळपेंचाची आपदा । आढळेचिना ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्या माणासाचे तेजच असें असतें कीं, तो कोणतेही काम धडाक्यानें करुन टाकतो. तेंच काम दुसर्‍यानें कितीही जपून केलें तरी त्यास ते जमत नाहीं. धडाक्यानें काम करणार्‍या माणसाला आंत एक बाहेर एक, लबाडी, व्यत्यय वगैरे अडचणी आड येत नाहींत.
owis.englishMeaning: Then this `ever free' has needs and desires and is always involved in doing something and this guarded intention of mula maya that just wants to know, is never there. But `there' in brahman, this unfortunate condition that brings only arrogance and trouble, is never met.

owis.original: येकासी अभ्यासितां न ये । येकासी स्वभावेंचि ये । ऐसा भगवंताचा महिमा काये । कैसा कळेना ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जी गोष्ट एखाद्या माणसाला अभ्यास करुनही येत नाही,  तीच गोष्ट दुसर्‍या एखाद्याला सहज जमतें. भगवंताचा हा अगाध महिमा आहे. त्याचा पत्ता लागत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: If to one this practice of `I am' (ie. forget everything) does not come and if to another, this `I am' comes naturally, then why can the greatness of that God not also be understood? (If this `I am' is the natural state for one and yet for another it cannot be found and may seem impossible then, why can that which is beyond this `I am' ie. that which cannot be concentrated upon, not also become the natural state for the one who sincerely seeks it? maharaj- where there is a will, there is a way)

owis.original: मोठीं राजकारणें चुकती । राजकारणा वेढा लागती । नाना चुकीची फजीती । चहुंकडे ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखदा माणूस जर मोठें राजकारण चुकला तर त्यामुळें सगळें लोक अडचणीनी वेढलें जातात. अशा अनेक चुका घडल्या तर मोठी फजिती होतें.
owis.englishMeaning: But if in that brahman, rajakarana is forgotten or neglected then, there is only the confusion and bewilderment that is within *rajakarana (then there is worldly politics; strategies and plans). If in every direction rajakarana is forgotten then, there is the disgrace and ridicule of the `many'. *(Generally rajakarana is believed to mean politics but maharaj said it meant understanding who the real King/raja is; He is the true doer. See chapter ahead)

owis.original: याकारणें चुकों नये । म्हणिजे उदंड उपाये । उपायाचा अपाये । चुकतां होये ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून राजकारणीं माणसानें सहसा चूक करुं नये. मग त्याच्या हाताशी पुष्कळ उपाय असतात. राजकारणी माणूस चुकला तर उपायाचा देखील अपाय होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: By the practice of this `speech' there should be no such forgetting and then, on account of this remedy of the `all', there can be that vast paramatma. However in order to know that paramatma, this remedy that is also harmful, has to be forgotten (this `all' understanding is a remedy against body consciousness but it is nevertheless harmful, for it conceals the Reality).

owis.original: काये चुकलें तें कळेना । मनुष्याचें मनचि वळेना । खवळला अभिमान गळेना । दोहिंकडे ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपलें काय चुकलें तें स्वतःला कळत नाहीं. ज्या माणसाबरोबर राजकारण चालूं असते, त्याचे मन कांहीं केल्या वळत नाहीं. आपल्या म्हणण्याला तो मान्यता देत नाहीं, अशा परिस्थितींत दोन्हीकडे अभिमान खवळलेला असतो. तो कांहीं कमी होत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: What to forget? That has not been understood and so the mind of the man does not change its direction (the mind, out of habit, feels that something should be know or remembered but such sadhana is not wanted `here'. He has not understood that, forgetting everything is real remembering). And even if one understands this `all' still, one does not want to drop this awakened pride of `I am brahman' (having dropped this "I am a body' feeling, this pleasure/ananda of being and knowing is intoxicating and one does not want to leave this. You have to die, but who wants to?).

owis.original: आवघे फडचि नासती । लोकांची मनें भंगती । कोठें चुकते युक्ती । कांहीं कळेना ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: याच्यामुळें राजकारण नासतें. दोन्ही बाजूंची जनता नाराज होऊन विस्कळीत होते. लोकांची मनें भंगून जातात. इतकें होऊनसुद्धा आपलें राजकारण कोठें चुकले तें कळत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to the `many' thoughts, this meeting place of the `all' gets destroyed and due to the mind of this `all', the `many' thoughts get destroyed. But this `thing' does not truly understand this trick/skill of forgetting (this `all' has to forget itself, if that Reality is to be understood).

owis.original: व्यापेंविण आटोप केला । तो अवघा घसरतचि गेला । अकलेचा बंद नाहीं घातला । दुरीदृष्टीनें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विवेक करुन पूर्वयोजना न आखतां जर लोकसमुदाय जमवला तर तो सांभाळता येत नाहीं. तेथें राजकारण व नेतेपणा घसरत जातो. प्रथमच दूरदृष्टी वापरुन विवेकानें ज्या मर्यादा घालायला पाहिजे होत्या त्या न घातल्यानें असा प्रसंग येतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If you don't pervade then, there is the gathering of the people (ie. worldly rajaka- rana) and that atma gets ruined by the `many' thoughts. And due to this seeing that is far from the atma ("I am the body and I see, hear, taste" etc.), that atma is confined and restrained and cannot open out (maharaj- you should be so open).

owis.original: येखादें मनुष्य तें सिळें । त्याचें करणेंचि बावळें । नाना विकल्पांचें जाळें । करुन टाकी ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा माणूस अगदींच कांहींतरी असतो. तो कळाहीन व कर्तृत्वहीन असतो. त्यावे सगळे करणें बावळटपणाचें असतें. आपल्या कामांत तो अनेक घोटाळ्यांचे जाळेंच निर्माण करुन ठेवतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Man makes that Reality dull and sluggish and then the actions of that purush are so *childish; for He has been caught in the net of `many' concepts. *(Children spend their day playing games, talking with themselves and their imaginary friends; they take a small stone and call it a cup and take another stone and call it a plate etc.; all imagination)

owis.original: तें आपणासी उकलेना । दुसर्‍यास कांहींच कळेना । नाचे विकल्पें कल्पना । ठांईं ठाईं ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ते जाळे त्याला स्वतःला उकलता येत नाहीं. दुसर्‍याला त्यांत कांहीं कळत नाहीं. आणि संशयाच्या पोटी कल्पना मात्र उगीच थैमान घालते.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that Reality cannot disentangle Itself and this `all thing' cannot understand itself either. Then due to the `many' concepts, that ever constant Reality, is imagined at every place.

owis.original: त्या गुप्त कल्पना कोणास कळाल्या । कोणें येऊन आटोपाव्या । ज्याच्या त्यानें कराव्या । बळकट बुद्धि ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याच्या अंतरंगांतील त्या गुप्त कल्पना दुसर्‍या कोणास कळत नाहींत. दुसरा कोणी त्यांना आवर घालूं शकत नाहीं. ज्यानें त्यानेंच आपल्या बुद्धिला घट्ट करुन, स्थिर करुन मनांत उसळणार्‍या कल्पनांना आवर घातला पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: How can imagination understand that hidden purush? How can one concept gather up and control the other concepts? Therefore one should have the fixed and determined buddhi of that purush.

owis.original: ज्यासी उपाधी आवडेना । तेणें उपाधी वाढवावीना । सावचित करुनियां मना । समाधानें असावें ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या माणसाला मोठ्या कामांची उपाधी आवरतां येत नसेल त्यानें मोठी कामें अंगावर घेऊन उपाधी वाढवूं नये. मनाला स्वस्थ करुन त्यानें समाधानांत राहावें.
owis.englishMeaning: If that purush does not keep His control over this limiting concept of `I am' then, this limiting concept will not be made to *grow (and it will fall again into the concept, "I am a jiva"). Therefore the mind should remain ever alert and gain that complete contentment. *(maharaj- make yourself to big that, you disappear)

owis.original: धांवधांवों उपाधी वेष्टी । आपण कष्टी लोक हि कष्टी । हे माना नये गोष्टी । कुसमुसेची ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादें काम घाईघाईनें कसेंतरी करुन टाकलें तर आपण कष्टी होतो. आणि लोकांनाही कष्टी करतो. अशा रीतीनें कसेंतरी काम करणें चांगलें नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: When that atma runs constantly after useless and troublesome ventures in this enwrapping concept of "I am a body", then you are troubled and this whole world is also troubled. You are that thoughtless Self and you should not want these stories that only bring tears and remorse.

owis.original: लोक बहुत कष्टी जाला । आपणहि अत्यंत त्रासला । वेर्थचि केला गल्बला । कासयासी ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समजा एखाद्या माणसाच्या कार्यानें लोकांना फार कष्ट झालें आणि तोहि अगदी त्रासून गेला, तर मग उगीच त्या कार्याची धडपड गडबड कशाला केली असें म्हणावें लागतें.
owis.englishMeaning: When this world of the `all' gets troubled then, you suffer greatly. Therefore why to create all this useless confusion?

owis.original: असो उपाधीचें काम । कांहीं बरें कांहीं काणोंसें । सकळ समजोन ऐसें । वर्ततां बरें ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असों. उपाधि म्हटली कीं, तिचें काम हें असेंच असतें. तिच्यामध्यें कांहीं चांगलें तर कांहीं उणे असायचेच. हें सगळें समजून वागणें केव्हांही बरें.
owis.englishMeaning: So be it! All this is the work of the concept `I am'. This `thing' can become thou- ghtless or this `thing' can become somebody. You can exist and function with wisdom only when you understand this `I am'.

owis.original: लोकांपासी भावार्थ कैचा । आपण जगवावा तयांचा । सेवट उपंढर कोणाचा । पडोंचि न ये ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जनतेपाशी कांहीं श्रद्धा किंवा निष्ठा नसतें. आपणच ती निर्माण करुन, जागृत ठेवावी लागते. शेवटी कोणाची फजिती होणार नाहीं याची काळजी घ्यावी.
owis.englishMeaning: Why has there to be this faith and conviction for this world of the `all'? It is so that you should awaken that Reality. Then, who will there be to fall into bewilderment? (When you are merged in that Reality, like the salt in the ocean then, you can never again return to body consciousness for, you no longer exist)

owis.original: अंतरात्म्याकडे सकळ लागे । निर्गुणीं हें कांहींच न लगे । नाना प्रकारीचे दगे । चंचळामधें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चंचळामध्यें घडणारें सगळें अंतरात्म्यापर्यंत जाते. निर्गुणाशीं त्याचा कांहींच संबंध नाहीं. चंचळामधें अनेक प्रकारचे धोके असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: In the charge of that antaratma, this `all' gets touched and that atma becomes sagun. But in that thoughtless nirgun, this `thing' is not required. Then how can there be the `many' frauds and deceits that are within this moving `thing'?

owis.original: शुद्ध विश्रांतीचें स्थळ । तें एक निर्मळ निश्र्चळ । तेथें चिकारचि सकळ । निर्विकार होती ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निर्मळ व निश्र्चळ परब्रह्म तें एकच शुद्ध विश्रांतीचे स्थळ आहे. तेथें चंचळाचे सगळे विकारच मुळीं निर्विकार होऊन जातात.
owis.englishMeaning: There is that pure place of complete rest and that is the One pure and still Reality. `There' this modification of the `all' becomes the unmodified (ie. parabrahman).

owis.original: उद्वेग अवघे तुटोनि जाती । मनासी वाटे विश्रांती । ऐसी दुल्लभ परब्रह्मस्थिती । विवेकें सांभाळावी ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तेथें सर्व दुःखें नाहींशी होऊन जातात. आणि मनाला एकदम विश्रांती मिळते. दुर्लभ असणारी अशीही परब्रह्मस्थिती, ही ब्राह्मी स्थिति विवेकाच्या जोरावर सांभाळावी. कायम टिकवावी.
owis.englishMeaning: When the dejection and disquiet of `many' thoughts are cut down then, the mind feels complete rest. In this way, that very *difficult to acquire, parabrahman, should be carefully maintained by vivek (see V. 10). *(He is the most difficult to acquire when you stay in the `many' thoughts)

owis.original: आपणास उपाधी मुळींच नाहीं । रुणानुबंधे मिळाले सर्वहि । आल्यागेल्याची क्षिती नाहीं । ऐसें जालें पाहिजे ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्याला मुळांत कांहीं उपाधि नाहीं. आपल्याभोवती असणारी माणसें हें सर्व ऋणानुबंधानें येतात. म्हणून कोणी येवो अगर जावो त्याची क्षिति होणें व तशी वृत्ति होणें जरुर आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: At the root there is not even this concept of you. This concept of the `all' has been encountered, due to right thinking in the past (ie. vivek). But there should be no concern given to it even, for it has come and so it has to also go. (This `all' is the original inspiration that has appeared upon that natural formless swarup and therefore it also has to go off)

owis.original: जो उपाधीस कंटाळला । तों निवांत होऊन बैसला । आटोपेना तो गलबला । कासयासी ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो या उपाधिला खर्‍या अर्थानें कंटाळतो, तो तिला बाजूला सारतो. मग अगदी निवांत होऊन शांत बसतो. जी उपाधि आपल्याला आवरता येत नाहीं तिची गडबड हवीच कशाला?
owis.englishMeaning: When that purush becomes wearied of this limiting concept, then that still swarup can be established. When there is no gathering together of this `thing' then, how will this paramatma ever get confused?

owis.original: कांहीं गल्बला कांहीं निवळ । ऐसा कठीण जावा काळ । जेणेंकरितां विश्रांती वेळ । आपणासी फावे ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कांहीं वेळेला उपाधिची गडबड असावी व कांहीं वेळ उपाधि अगदी नसावी. अशारीतीनें आपण काळ कंठीत जावा. त्यामुळें आपल्याला विश्रांती घेण्यास वेळ मिळतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is this `thing' then, there is a tumultuous clamour and when there is this `thing' then, there is peace and quiet. In this way, this time of the `all' has to be endured (tumultuous clamour comes and goes and peace and quiet comes and goes, but you are always there). On account of this `I am', the periods of the `many' become that perfect place of rest and you will have understood Yourself completely and gained victory.

owis.original: उपाधी कांहीं राहात नाहीं । समाधानायेवढें थोर नाहीं । नरदेहे प्राप्त होत नाहीं । क्षणक्षणा ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगांतील उपाधि आपल्याकरितां कांहीं अडून बसत नाहीं. मनाच्या समाधाना इतकी श्रेष्ठ गोष्ट जगामध्यें दुसरी नाहीं. मनावदेह परत परत मिळत नाहीं. माणसानें आपलें समाधान साधावें व टिकवावें.
owis.englishMeaning: When this concept of the `thing' is not remaining then, that great brahman is not (when maya is not then where is brahman?). This much is complete contentment (it is the `inexpressible' parabrahman) and then the concept of a human body never appears. (Therefore `I am' and "I am somebody" are both limiting concepts because you are there. maharaj- you should not have the wish of life even) .

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: ज्ञानी आणि उदास । समुदाताचा हव्यास । तेणें अखंड सावकाश । येकांत सेवावा ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एक आत्मज्ञानी व अत्यंत अलिप्त वृत्ति असलेला माणूस आहे. त्याला लोकसमुदाय करायची हौस असेल तर त्यानें तसें करावें पण प्रथम अखंड एकांत सेवन करुन विवेक करावा व विचारानें कार्य कोणतें करावें, तें कसें करावें याची योजना आखावी.
owis.englishMeaning: There is the gnyani and there is the one who is indifferent to this world and has a longing for this meeting place of the `all'. When he meets this `world beyond' then, he should taste the `aloneness' of that unbroken parabrahman (ie. the gnyani).

owis.original: जेथें तजवीजा कळती । अखंड चाळणा निघती । प्राणीमात्राची स्थिती गती । कळों येते ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याला योजना सुचतात आणि तो ज्यांच्यावर विचार करतो, त्याला उपायही पुष्कळ सुचतता. त्याला लोकांची परिस्थिति समजते व त्यांना पुढें कसें न्यावें हे समजते.
owis.englishMeaning: If `here' proper judgment is exercised and a carefull search is made then, that unbro- ken parabrahman will be found. For the jiva in only the prana can understand that Reality (ie. then the jiva with all the thoughts can become that thoughtless Reality if he is indifferent to this world and has a longing for knowledge).9

owis.original: जरी हा चाळणाचि करीना । तरी कांहींच उमजेना । हिसेबझाडाचि पाहीना । दिवाळखोर ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा रीतीनें लोकांच्या परिस्थितिचा जो विचार करीत नहीं त्याला उपायही सुतच नाहींत. एखादा दिवाळखोर  माणूस जसा हिशोबझाडा करीत नाहीं, तसें हें घडते.
owis.englishMeaning: If this search is not made and this `thing' is not understood then, it will be just like one who spends lavishly without keeping any accounts. He is sure to become bankrupt in the end (ie. real wealth is this `thing'/knowledge or life. A dying king would give away his kingdom if he could just live the fullness of life for another day. But if you don't try to know this beautiful gift that you have been given and just accumulate wealth borrowed from this wealth of `I am'; and if you live as a body and just use this life for selfish gains then, you are sure to suffer and die one day within this thing called life; your true wealth).

owis.original: येक मिरासी साधिती । येक सीध्या गवाविती । व्यापकपणाची स्थिती । ऐसी आहे ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एकजण विचारानें व शहाणपणानें वागून इनामी वतन मिळवितो, तर दुसरा आविचारानें व मूर्खपणानें वागून आपलें वतन गमावून बसतो. सगळीकडे लक्ष देऊन वागण्याची स्थिति ही अशी आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: 9ranjit maharaj- To behave nobly means to let each one act according to his/her desire. Otherwise, one forms a habit of censuring others. One should never speak ill of others. Also, never bother yourself with petty observations about others. Do not meddle in others' affairs. This is called charity. 4. One acquires the property that is his by right and another, though it is achievable, lets it slip away. This all depends upon one's pervasiveness (when that One is `all' pervasive He acquires His own property and when that One is a jiva then, he pervades a body only).

owis.original: जेणें जें जें मनीं धरिलें । तें तें आधींच समजलें । कृत्रिम अवघेंचि खुंटलें । सहजचि येणें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दुसर्‍याच्या मनांत जे हेतु असतात, तें जर आपल्याला आधींच समजलें तर मग त्यांचे कपट आपल्याला आपोआपच थांबविता येईल.
owis.englishMeaning: When mula maya holds mula maya in the mind, then that Reality at the source will be understood. Then this false world caused by the `many' thoughts is brought to an end, on account of this natural `speech' and thoughtlessness.

owis.original: अखंड राहतां सलगी होते । अतिपरिचयें अवज्ञा घडते । याकारणें विश्रांती ते । घेता नये ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एकाच ठिकाणीं सतत राहिल्यानें सलगी वाढते. अति परिय झाल्यामुळें मान तेथे राहात नाहीं. यासाठी महंतानें एकाच ठिाकाणी विश्रांती घेत सतत राहूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that unbroken brahman stays intimate with prakruti. But if He becomes too intimate with her then, she will lead Him to disgrace (detachment should be maintained otherwise, there is the disgrace of becoming a body again). Then on account of this `speech', that Reality does not get complete rest and repose (then this `I am' falls back into body consciousness).

owis.original: आळसें आळस केला । तरी मग कारबारचि बुडाला । अंतरहेत चुकत गेला । समुदायाचा ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आळसाच्या आवडीनें जर कामाचा आळस केला तर मग सगळ्या कारभाराचा नाश होतो. लोकसमुदायाला मार्गदर्शन करुन कार्यरत करण्याचा मनामधील हेतू तसाच राहून जातो.
owis.englishMeaning: Laziness only increases laziness and drowns this great endeavour to be He. When this original intent to simply know is neglected then, this meeting place of the `all' gets washed away.

owis.original: उदंड उपासनेचीं कामें । लावीत जावीं नित्यनेमें । अवकाश कैंचा कृत्रिमें । करावयासी ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नित्यनेमानें करायची अशी उपासनेची पुष्कळ कामें लोकसमुदायामागें लावून द्यावी. लोक त्यामधें गुंतून राहिले कीं मग लबाडी करायला कोणासही सवड मिळत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When that vast paramatma has a wish to worship then, that `all' is always there (ie. then He is seeing His reflection). And when you understand this space (ie. when nothing is there, I am there) then, how can there be the `many' impure actions? (maharaj- first space is there and then the world appears)

owis.original: चोर भांडारी करावा । घसरतांच सांभाळावा । गोवा मूर्खपणाचा काढावा । हळु हळु ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चोराला भांडारावर मुख्य नेमावा. जर तो कधी  घसरला, जर त्यानें कधीं चोरी केली तर त्याला क्षमा करुन सांभाळून घ्यावा. त्याच्या मूर्खपणांतून त्यला हळुंहळुं बाहेर काढावा.
owis.englishMeaning: The thief should be put in charge of the *treasury and even if he steals still, he should be watched over and taught. Then gradually his entanglement with foolishness can be taken out. *(This `I am' is your treasure; previously the mind had stolen this away and taken it to use himself, "I am a body"; but if he is made to understand this `I am' then, he will become your best friend and will not allow this `I am' to be stolen away by anyone in this world)

owis.original: या अवघ्या पहिल्याच गोष्टी । प्राणी कोणी नव्हता कष्टी । राजकारणें मंडळ वेष्टी । चहुंकडे ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या सार्‍या गोष्टी पूर्वीपासून चालत आल्या आहेत. चोरासगट कोणत्याही माणसाला त्याज्य न समजतां सर्वांना आपल्या कार्यामधे खुबीनें गुंतवून ठेवावें.
owis.englishMeaning: When the `many' thoughts are this original thought `I am' then, there is the not the harassment of that one in the prana. This is called rajakarana and then the whole assembly is protected in every direction (then, `He does everything').

owis.original: नष्टासी नष्ट योजावे । वाचाळासी वाचाळ आणावे । आपणावरी विकल्पाचे गोवे । पडोंच नेदी ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो नष्ट आहे त्याच्या मुकाबल्यासाठी नष्ट आणून ठेवावा. जो वाचाळ असेल त्याच्या समोर दुसरा वाचाळ आणून ठेवावा. आपल्यासंबंधी दुसर्‍याच्या मनांत संशय किंवा विकल्प निर्माण होईल असें कांहीं करुं नये. आपलें अलिप्तपण सांभाळून आपण वागावें.
owis.englishMeaning: The evil should meet the evil and the talkative should be brought to the talkative (ie. let the world do what it chooses, why should I care; maintain your detachment and witness this world; life is their teacher and they will learn for themselves the error of their ways). But this entanglement of body consciousness should not be allowed to fall upon you.

owis.original: कांटीनें कांटी झाडावी । झाडावी परी तें कळों नेदावी । कळकटेपणाची पदवी । असों द्यावी ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: काट्यानें काटा काढावा म्हणजे एका दुर्जनाकडून दुसर्‍या दुर्जनाचा बंदोबस्त करावा. पण तें कोणीं घडवून आणलें तें कोणास कळूं देऊं नये. आपण बावळट आहोत, चतुर नाहीं; असा लोकांचा आपल्याबद्दल असलेला समज तसाच राहूं द्यावा.
owis.englishMeaning: A thorn should be removed by a thorn. And then this thorn should also be removed, for it cannot give that nirgun understanding. That nirgun authority that was soiled should not be bestowed upon this sagun (ie. when this concept of "I am a body" goes off, don't mistake this sagun understanding for that nirgun). (maharaj- this `I am' understanding is the thorn that removes the many concepts and thoughts; but this thorn also needs to be tossed away, otherwise it will prick you)

owis.original: न कळतां करी कार्य जें तें । तें काम तत्काळचि होतें । गचगर्चेंत पडतां तें । चमत्कारें नव्हे ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लोकांत फारसा बोभाटा न करतां जें कार्य करावें तें चटकन पार पडतें. लोकांत त्याचा फार गवगवा झाला तर त्यामधील नवलाई नाहींशी होतें.
owis.englishMeaning: When complete understanding has not come, then mula maya is this action and that Reality becomes the doer. And afterwards that Reality appears as the action (purush/prakruti appears ie. witnessing; but if that purush does not maintain His deta- 10 maharaj the mind is the thief. A thief is very alert and knows all the tricks and will not let another steal from there. If he is forgiven gradually his trust will be gained. chment then, He will identify Himself as His prakruti). And if too much noise is made in the mind then, this miracle of `I am the doer everywhere' is lost to the body ego.

owis.original: ऐकोनी आवडी लावावी । देखोनी बळकटचि व्हावी । सलगीनें आपली पदवी । सेवकामधें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: महंताची कीर्ति ऐकून त्याच्याविषयीं लोकांच्या मनांत आवड उत्पन्न व्हावी. त्याच्या प्रत्यक्ष दर्शनानें ती बळकट व्हावी. आणि त्याच्याशी सलगी झाल्यावर त्याच्या सेवकांपैकी एक होण्यांत भूषण वाटावें.
owis.englishMeaning: One should be fond of this listening and one should search out this `all' through steady determination. And then due to this association with the `all' there will be that Reality, which is yours by right. *(maharaj- this understanding is your birthright)

owis.original: कोणीयेक काम करितां होतें । न करितां तें पडतें । या कारणें ढिलेपण तें । असोंचि नये ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: काम कोणतेहि असो तें केलें तर सिद्धिस जातें, केले नाहीं तर तें मागें पडतें. म्हणून कोणतेही काम करण्यामधे ढिलेपण असूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: The One atma who is within everyone has to do this action; for if He does not do it then, that Reality will fall down into body consciousness. Therefore He should never neglect this `speech'. (The One has an association with the `all' but He is not this `all' and is concealed very close by. Therefore always have the understanding, `Whatever is seen or perceived is not; Still He is there').

owis.original: जो दुसर्‍यावरी विश्र्वासला । त्याचा कार्यभाग बुडाला । जो आपणचि कष्टत गेला । तोचि भला ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जोदुसर्‍यावर  विश्र्वासून राहतो त्याचा कार्यभाग नाश पावतो. जो आपण स्वतः कष्ट करतो तोच भला होय.
owis.englishMeaning: When that purush puts faith in the `all' then, that goal (to understand one's Self) which is to be accomplished gets drowned. But when that purush itself takes all the trouble, then He becomes wise (ie. constant vivek of detachment is required).

owis.original: अवघ्यास अवघें कळलें । तेव्हां तें रितें पडिलें । याकारणें ऐसें घडलें । न पाहिजें कीं ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एकाद्या कार्याबद्दल सर्वांना सर्व गोष्टी कळल्या तर तें कार्य मागें पडते. तें नीट होणार नाहीं. म्हणून असें होणार नाहीं याची काळजी घेतली पहिजे. ज्या माणसाकडून कार्याचा जेवढा भाग करुन घ्यावयाचा असेल तेवढ्यापुरतीच माहिती त्यास द्यावी. सबंध कार्याची माहिती देऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: If everybody knows everybody else then, that Reality has fallen into the emptiness of this mundane existence. Such should never happen and therefore forget everybody and maintain this `speech' (maharaj- understand these are not my relatives. They are relatives of the body).

owis.original: मुख्य सूत्र हातीं घ्यावें । करणें तें लोकांकरवी करवावें । कित्तेक खलक उगवावे । राजकारणामधें ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कार्याचे मुख्य सूत्र आपल्या हातीं ठेवावे. जें कांही करायचे ते लोकांकडून करवून घ्यावें. आपल्या कार्याच्या व्यवहारामधें पुष्कळ साधी माणसें पुढें आणावी. त्यांना कार्यकर्ते बनवावे.
owis.englishMeaning: That Supreme should take possession of this `all' connection and through this `all', That should make His `action' (ie. He should use knowledge to stay in the world). This understanding is rajakarana and due to this, that One in the `many' should unravel this whole world and be free.

owis.original: बोलके पहिलवान कळकटे । तयासीच घ्यावे झटे । दुर्जनें राजकारण दाटे । ऐसें न करावें ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जे बडबडे व भांडकुदळ बळकट पुढारी असतात त्यांच्याशी झुंज द्यावी. व त्यांना पराजीत करावें. दुर्जनांमुळें आपलें राजकारण अडून बसलें असें होवूं देऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: If someone is talkative, of a fighting nature and impure then, he should be dealt with quickly by rajakarana (don't pamper the thoughts of your ego). But one should not get involved with this rajakarana of the ignorant who are far from the Self (ie. "I am a body", then there is worldly politics and scheming and manipulation).

owis.original: ग्रामण्य वर्मीं सांपडावें । रगडून पीठचि करावें । करुनि मागुती सांवरावें । बुडऊं नये ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गांवगुंडीचें रहस्य शोधून काढावें आणि गांवगुंडांना हैराण करुन नरम पाडावें. व आपलेसें करुन घ्यावें. त्यांना साफ नाहिसें करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: The disputes within that essence should be uncovered and they should be utterly crushed and forced out (ie. in the beginning, mind does not want to change and raises `many' doubts). Then afterwards the mind should be allowed back and restored to strength and need not be suppressed.12

owis.original: खळदुर्जनासी भ्यालें । राजकारण नाहीं राखिलें । तेणें अवघें प्रगट जालें । बरें वाईट ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दुष्ट व दुर्जन यांच्या भयानें जर आपण आपलें राजकारण सांभाळलें नाहीं तर राजकारणांतील बरें वाईट सर्व उघड होऊन कार्याचा नाश होईल.
owis.englishMeaning: If the vile and far from the atma has fear then, rajakarana is not being protected and then that Reality has manifested as the `many' thoughts and the best guna becomes these worst gunas. (maharaj fear is the base of the mind.)

owis.original: समुदाव पाहिजे मोठा । तरी तनावा असाव्या बळकटा । मठ करुनी ताठा । धरुं नये ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मोठा लोकसमुदाय करायचा असेल तर त्याला सावरुन धरणारे नियम देखील तसेंच बळकट असावयास हवेत. महंतानें मठ करुन उगीच अभिमान धरुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: If that brahman wants this sacred meeting place, then that upholder of this place should be very strong and determined. This sacred place (ie. knowledge) should be built, but it should be managed without any pride (ie. use knowledge but do not be this knowledge).

owis.original: दुर्जन प्राणी समजावे । परी ते प्रगट न करावे । सज्जनापरीस आळवावे । महत्व देउनी ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समुदायामधील दुर्जन माणसें ओळखून ठेवावीत. पण त्यांना प्रगट करुं नये. त्यांना सज्जनासारखें महत्व द्यावें. त्यांना मोठेपणादेऊन आपलेसें करावे.
owis.englishMeaning: 11 raja-king, karana-cause or doer. To know the king who does all is rajakarana, not the lower rajakarana which is how to control people. 12 maharaj in the beginning the mind should be annihilated. Then after let thoughts come and go, for you know you are not the thoughts. 23. The one far from the atma and within the prana should be understand (ie. made into the knowledge of this `all'). And then afterwards, that Reality should not be made into this manifest `all'. The Saint can be compared to the paris stone,13 for by means of this `all', He bestows His greatness upon you.

owis.original: जनामधें दुर्जन प्रगट । तरी मग अखंड खटपट । याकारणें ते वाट । बुझुनि टाकावी ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दुर्जनाला लोकांमध्यें प्रगट केला तर ती एक कायमची कटकट होवून बसते. म्हणून तो मार्ग बंदच करुन टाकावा.
owis.englishMeaning: If the one far from the atma is manifest in this world then, that unbroken brahman is disputes and chatter only. Therefore by means of this `speech', these `many' side roads should be closed off and abandoned.

owis.original: गनीमाच्या देखतां फौजा । रणशूरांच्या फुर्फुरिती भुजा । ऐसा पाहिजे कीं राजा । कैपक्षी परमार्थी ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शत्रूचे सैन्य पाहिलें कीं रणशूरांचे बाहू स्फूरण पावूं लागतात. त्याचप्रमाणें राजा परमार्थाचा कैवार घेणारा असला पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: While seeing the enemy's army, the arm of the brave warrior quivers with eagerness. Such eagerness is required in paramarth and then that King (ie. atma) becomes ones constant support (then He does everything).

owis.original: तयास देखतां दुर्जन धाके । बैसवी प्रचीतीचे तडाखे । बंडपाषांडाचे वाखे । सहजचि होती ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो राजा असा पाहिजे कीं, त्याला पाहून दुर्जनांना भय वाटावें. तो दुर्जनांना तडाखे मारतो. अशी प्रचीति पाहिजे म्हणजे बंडे आणि पाखंडें आपोआपच बंद होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When the one far from the atma (ie. the indecisive and confused mind) catches sight of the King, he is in awe. And when that far from the atma is established in this `experience' then, the revolt and utterances of this imposter (ie. ego) become that Reality.

owis.original: हे धूर्तपणाची कामें । राजकारण करावें नेमें । ढिलेपणाच्या संभ्रमें । जाऊं नये ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हीं खरोखर मोठ्या चतुराईची कामें आहेत. महंतानें अगदी व्यवस्थितपणें राजकारण करावें. उगीच ढिलेपणाच्या भ्रमानें वागूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: That thoughtless atma has need of intelligence and therefore rajakarana should be constantly performed. Confusion caused by laziness and negligence should never be allowed to enter.

owis.original: कोठेंच पडेना दृष्टीं । ठाईं ठाईं त्याच्या गोष्टी । वाग्विळासें सकळ सृष्टी । वेधिली तेणें ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा पुढारी महंताला पाहायला जावें तर तों कोठें दृष्टीस पडूं नये. पण ठिकठिकाणी लोकांनी त्याच्याबद्दल चर्चा करावी. आपल्या वक्तृत्वानें असा महंत सर्व लोकांना आपल्याकडे आकर्षून घेत असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When this visible `all' does not tumble down into body consciousness then there is this `story' of that purush. Due to this, the sweet and gentle `speech' of this `all' penetrates the whole mundane existence.

owis.original: हुंब्यासीं हुंबा लाऊन द्यावा । टोणप्यास टोणपा आणावा । लौंदास पुढें उभा करावा । दुसरा लौंद ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: घुम्याची घुम्याशी जोड घालून द्यावी. मूर्खाशी मूर्खाची जोड व धटिंगणाशी धटिंगणाची जोड घालून द्यावी. एका धटिंगणासमोर दुसरा धटिमगण उभा करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: The complaining and depressed should be placed in contact with the complaining and depressed. The dull-minded and stubborn should be brought to the stubborn and dull-minded; and the abundant `all' should stand before this abundant `all'. (Let this world do what it wants to do. Let each jiva be in the company it chooses to be in; that is not my concern; for knowledge wants only knowledge)

owis.original: धटासी आणावा धट । उत्धटासी पाहिजे उत्धट । खटनटासी खटनट । अगत्य करी ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दांडग्यासमोर दांडगा उभा करावा. उद्धटाच्या तोंडाशी दुसरा उद्धटच द्यावा. दुष्ट भांडखोर दुर्जनाला तसाच दुष्ट व भांडखोर दुर्जन आणून ठेवावा.
owis.englishMeaning: The bold should be brought to the bold. The intrepid wants the intrepid and the vile has interest in only the vile.

owis.original: जैशास तैसा जेव्हां भेटे । तेव्हां मज्यालसी थाटे । इतुकें होतें परी धनी कोठें । दृष्टीस न पडे ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा रीतीनें जशास तसा भेटला म्हणजे सभेला रंग भरतो. परंतु या सर्व राजकारणाचीं सूत्रें हालवणारा मालक मात्र कोठेंच दृष्टीस पडूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: When one meets another of one's own *kind then, their power is properly orchestra- ted. But even while so much is going on, still that Lord never falls into this place of the visible `all' (ie. He wants only His `aloneness'). *(The formless shishya wants His formless Lord) .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Vivek Lakshan Nirupan (A Discourse on the Attributes of Vivek)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: जेथें अखंड नाना चाळणा । जेथें अखंड नाना धारणा । जेथें अखंड राजकारणा । मनासी आणिती ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या ठिकाणी राजकारण करणारा महंत असतो, त्या ठिकाणी सतत अनेक चिषयांवर विचारविनिमय चालूं असतो. तेथें अनेक प्रकारच्या गोष्टी एकाग्रतेनें मनांत वागवल्या जातात. आणि अनेक प्रकारच्या राजकीय समस्यांवर चिंतन चालतें.
owis.englishMeaning: In maya there is that unbroken parabrahman and the `many' different forms of searching; in maya there is that unbroken parabrahman and the `many' different un- derstandings; in maya there is that unbroken parabrahman and the rajakarana that is brought from the mind (ie. worldly politics, scheming and manipulation).

owis.original: सृष्टीमधें उत्तम गुण । तितुकें चाले निरुपण । निरुपणाविण क्षण । रिकामा नाहीं ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगांत जे उत्तम गुण आहेत ते आपण कसें शिकावे याची चर्चा तेथें होते. खरें म्हणजे या गुणांचे वर्णन आणि भगवंत निरुपण, याशिवाय एक क्षण रीकामा जात नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Within this gross world there is that best guna and then That moves and there is this sagun discourse. No where is there to be found an empty moment without this `I am' discourse.14

owis.original: चर्चा आशंका प्रत्योत्तरें । कोण खोटे कोण खरें । नाना वगत्रुत्वें शास्त्राधारें । नाना चर्चा ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तेथें अनेक शंका काढून त्यांचे निरसन केलें जातें. कोण खरें व कोण खोटे याचे निश्र्चित केलें जातें. अनेक प्रकारची वक्तव्यें ऐकाला मिलतात. आणि शास्त्राचा आधार घेऊन अनेक चर्चा होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The idle slander and doubts are due to this `I am', but tell me, which one is true and which is false? There are the `many' eloquent speeches and the `many' rumours on account of the scriptures but, in the end, the scriptures say only neti, neti (not this, not that, but still, `I am' there).

owis.original: भक्तिमार्ग विशद कळे । उपासनामार्ग आकळे । ज्ञानविचार निवळे । अंतर्यामीं ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तेथें भक्तिमार्गाचे स्वरुप स्पष्टपणें कळतें. उपासनामार्गाचे आकलन होतें. माणसाच्या अंतर्यामी ज्ञानविचार संशयरहित होऊन जातो.
owis.englishMeaning: When the path of devotion is clearly understood and the path of worship is clearly understood then, there is the thoughtlessness of pure knowledge and this purifies the inner heart (devotion, worship and knowledge become one when there is thoughtles- sness)

owis.original: वैराग्याची बहु आवडी । उदास वृत्तीची गोडी । उदंड उपाधी तरी सोडी । लागोंच नेदी ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समाजनेत्या महंताला वैराग्याची मोठी आवड असते. अलिप्तपणांत त्याला मनापासून गोडी वाटते. त्याच्या मागें पुष्कळ भानगडी असतात. पण मनानें तो त्यांना चिकटून नसतो. त्या सोडायच्या म्हटल्या तर तो केंव्हाही सोडून देऊं शकतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When the `many' thoughts have a fondness for vairagya and an attraction to this *vritti of detachment then, that vast paramatma becomes this `I am'; yet still it is not allowed to be free. *(`I do not want to know `many' things; I just want to know)

owis.original: प्रबंदाचीं पाठांतरें । उत्तरासी संगीत उत्तरें । नेमक बोलतां अंतरें । निववी सकळांचीं ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याला पुष्कळ साहित्य ग्रंथ पाठ असतात. प्रश्रणांना त्यानें दिलेली उत्तरें व्यवस्थित असतात. त्याच्या योग्य व नेमक्या बोलण्यानें सर्वांच्या मनाला शांती मिळते.
owis.englishMeaning: When this continuous connection is always felt, then there is the singing of this `I am' to this `I am' and it resounds throughout the whole world. Then that One `speaks' as it was meant to `speak' and is pacified by this inner space of the `all'.

owis.original: आवडी लागली बहु जना । तेथें कोणाचें कांहीं चालेना । दळवट पडिला अनुमाना । येईल कैसा ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लोकांचे त्याच्यावर फार प्रेम असते. म्हणून त्याच्यापुढें कोणाचे कांहीं चालत नाहीं. त्याच्याभोवती नेहमी गर्दी असते. पण त्याचे अंतरंग फारच थोड्या लोकांना माहित असते.
owis.englishMeaning: But when that One has a love for the `many' people then, `there' and this `all thing' cannot properly function. For how can the tramped and trodden baseless thoughts, come `there'?

owis.original: उपासना करुनियां पुढें । पुरवलें पाहिजे चहुंकडे । भूमंडळीं जिकडे तिकडे । जाणती तया ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो स्वतः उपासना आचरतो. उपासनेच्या प्रसारासाठीं तो सगळीकडे भ्रमण करतो. त्यामुळें जगांत जिकडे तिकडे तो माहित असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: After having made proper worship/upasana (ie. to take the mind that was sitting with the objects and place it near God ie. `He does everything'), that atma should pervade in all four directions. Then everywhere in the world is known by Him.

owis.original: जाणती परी आडळेना । काये करितो तें कळेना । नाना देसीचे लोक नाना । येऊन जाती ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लोकांना तो माहित असला तरी फारसा दृष्टीस पडत नाहीं. तो काय करतो तें कळत नाहीं. अनेक देशांतील अनेक लोक त्याच्याकडे येऊन जातात.
owis.englishMeaning: The Knower knows but He cannot be met and no matter how much He does, still He cannot understand that Reality (that is the antar-atma, the Knower of this `all' and the most active of all). And if there are the `many' destructible states and the `many' destructible worlds then, He comes and goes (as a jiva; when you sleep the Knower goes off and when you awake the Knower awakes). (Understanding means nothing can be done to achieve that Reality; siddharameshwar maharaj- doing nothing is the greatest worship)

owis.original: तितुक्यांचीं अंतरें धरावीं । विवेकें विचारें भरावीं । कडोविकडीचीं विवरावीं । अंतःकर्णें ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भेटायला येणार्‍या अशा सगळ्याचें अंतरंग आपलें करुन घ्यावें. त्यांचें अंतरंग विवेकानें व विचारानें भरुन टाकावे. त्यांच्यापैकी जे एकांतिक वृत्तीचे असतात. त्यांचे अंतःकरण विवेकानें समतोल बनवावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore only this inner space should be kept in your mind and then on account of this vivek, your mind should be filled up with thoughtlessness. But such investigation requires a very sharp antah-karana (knowing faculty).

owis.original: किती लोक तें कळेना । किती समुदाव आकळेना । सकळ लोक श्रवणमनना । मध्यें घाली ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याला भेटायला किती लोक येतात त्यांची गणती नसते. त्याच्या अनुयायांच्या संख्येची कल्पना येत नाहीं. पण सर्वांनाच तो श्रवण मननाचा मार्ग शिकवतो. त्यांना श्रवण मनन करायला पात्र करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The world of the `many' cannot understand that Reality and yet, these `many' thoughts cannot confine this meeting place of the `all'. Therefore this world of the `all' between the `many' and that Reality is to be established by listening/shravan and manana.

owis.original: फड समजाविसी करणें । गद्यपद्य सांगणें । परंतरासी राखणें । सर्वकाळ ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण निर्माण केलेल्या समूहांतील लोकांची समजूत घालणें, गद्य, पद्य लिहून घेण्यास सांगणें सदासर्वकाळ दुसर्‍याचें अंतःकरण सांभाळणें,
owis.englishMeaning: When a proper understanding of this worldly market *place is formed then, the tedious and tasteless deceits become that thoughtless Self. Therefore this time of the `all' is to be protected and then only can one become that Reality. *(This world is a market place of concepts)

owis.original: ऐसा ज्याचा दंडक । अखंड पाहाणें विेवेक । सावधापुढें अविवेक । येईल कैचा ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असा त्याचा नित्यक्रम असल्यानें अहोरात्र तो अत्यंत विवेकानें वागतो. असा सावधपणा ठेवून वागल्यामुळें अविवेक त्याच्याजवळ येत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When such is the practice of that purush, then there is vivek and that unbroken parabrahman can be understood. Once there is such alertness, how can there be any a-vivek?

owis.original: जितुकें कांहीं आपणासी ठावें । तितुकें हळुहळु सिकवावें । का शाहाणें करुनि सोडावे । बहुत जन ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जितकें कांहीं आपल्यापाशी ज्ञान असेल तितकें लोकांना हळुहळु धीमेपणानें शिकवावें. अशा रीतीनें पुष्कळ लोक शहाणे करावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When this `thing' knows its self, then that gradually should be taught vignyan. Through wisdom this `all' of the `people' should be set free (this `all' is within this world of the `many' and it is the base of this world of the `many' thoughts).

owis.original: परोपरीं सिकवणें । आडणुका सांगत जाणें । निवळ करुनी सोडणें । निस्पृहासी ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो निःस्पृह आहे आणि महंत होण्यास लायक आहे. अशा पुरुषाला तर परोपरीनें शिकवावें. अडचणी व अडवणुका सांगत जाव्या.आणि त्याला अगदी निःसंदेह करुन सोडावा.
owis.englishMeaning: The desireless understand this teaching that is within the `many' ways. For He knows this original doubt `I am' and then makes that thoughtless. For then, He throws out that which has been purified and cleaned (ie. this `I am').

owis.original: होईल तें आपण करावें । न होतां जनाकरवीं करवावें । भगवद्भजन राहावें । हा धर्म नव्हे ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लोककार्यापैकी जेवढें होईल तेवढें आपण करावें, आपल्या हातून होत नसेल, ते जनतेकडून करवून घ्यावें. पण भगवंताचे भजन मागें पडेल हा कांहीं धर्म नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Whatever is going to happen, should be made by Him (when He wants nothing and does nothing then, everything happens naturally). That which is not, is made by the doings of the people of this world (ie. they don't accept what is; they say; "I want this and this", "I don't want to do that" etc. In this way, they miss that which is there and by creating so many actions, they have to endure their repercussions). One should maintain this bhajan of God (ie. knowledge) and then, be that thoughtless Self that is devoid of any dharma.15

owis.original: आपण करावें करवावें । आपण विवरावें विवरवावें । आपण धरावें धरवावें । भजनमार्गासी ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण स्वतः करावें आणि इतरांकडून करवून घ्यावें. आपण विवेक करावा आणि इतरंकडून करवून घ्यावा. आपण भक्तिमार्ग धरावा आणि इतरांना भक्तिमार्ग धरायला लावावा.
owis.englishMeaning: You should make your mind do that which should be done (let whatever is going to come, come. What have I to do with that?). You should make your mind investigate that which should be investigated. You should make your mind hold firmly to the path of bhajan, for that is what should be firmly held.

owis.original: जुन्या लोकांचा कंटाळा आला । तरी नूतन प्रांत पाहिजे धरिला । जितुकें होईल तितुक्याला । आळस करुं नये ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जुन्या लोकांचा कंटाळा आला तर नविन ठिकाणी जाऊन महंती करावी. तेथें आपल्याकडून जेवढें होईल तेवढें करावें, आळस करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: When one has grown weary of the old world of old thoughts, then this new and ever-fresh place should be firmly held. Anything may come but still there should never be any laziness (ie. inattentiveness).

owis.original: देह्याचा अभ्यास बुडाला । म्हणिजे महंत बुडाला । लागवेगें नूतन लोकांला । शाहाणें करावें ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहाचा अभ्यास बुडाला कीं, महंत बुडाला. म्हणून शक्य तितक्या लवकर नविन लोकांना शहाणें करावें. महंतानें आपल्या देहाला सारखा लोकसेवेमध्यें राबवला पाहिजे. तो आळसावला कीं, सर्व लोकसमुदाय आळसावतो. त्यामुळें उपासना ढिली पडते व कार्याचा नाश होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If the practice of being this `all' body is drowned then, that purush is drowned (if this `all' body is drowned in the thoughts of this world then you, that Knower cannot maintain detachment and will also be drowned by such thoughts). Therefore this ever-new and fresh world should be created by the wise (maharaj- no need to change anything).
